eng_text: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

eng_text: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

eng_text: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

eng_text: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Mayi adi enza tshizubu tsha katshiyi tshimueneka pamutu pa mayi tshidi tshenza ne bintu bu lushingi lubande pamutu pa mayi.
eng_text: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Tuamua tu bisabata bia mu neje bia mpidiewu, bidi ni nseka ibidi ni tshina munkatshi. Nseke ibidi eyi idi isombesha bimpe pa neje nasha mu kobame.
eng_text: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Mudi muinshi mua kamua muikale mukobame, padi kamua kakobama ku luseke lumue, anyi lukuabu, luseka ludi lupetangana nineje lukobambialu.
eng_text: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Bidi bikudimuna muendedi wa mu neje. Padi bisabata bia mu neje bilala ku diabalume, muntu uya biende ku diabalume, biobio bilale ku diabakaji, muntu uya biende ku diabakaji.
eng_text: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Bua kupingana ku makanda abu a tuadijilu, badi ni tsha kumbusha makanda a pamutu mapeta ku bukenke.
eng_text: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Bidi bituma ka bukenke kakese kadi kabikidibua "photon".
eng_text: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Bena mikanda badi babikila ngezelu ewu "dituma ditumbula dia tusesa" bualu ma atome badi ba atumbula kudi bukenke bua bukole, kibidi bifila dituma dia photon wa bukenke, ni bukenke budi mushindu mukuabu wa kuasa nsesa.
eng_text: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Image ewu udiuleja ma atome atuma ma photon. Mu bulelela, ma photon adi makese bikole kupita idi pa image.
eng_text: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Photon itu mikese kupita bintu bitu munda mua ma atomes.
eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Kunyima ku meba lukama a ditumika, tushinga tua mu muendu tudi tufikila ku dipia, ni muendu kayi utumika kabidi to.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Muendu udi nitshakushuntudibua. Bidi bia dijinga bua kutalama diba dia dishuntula dia muendu.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Tshakumpala, kujima kua kutemeshela muendu anyi kumbusha nshinga.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Tshitupa tshinene tshia kuendesha natshi mu mubidi tshidi muoyo, udi usukuma mashi.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Mashi idi iumbuka mu moyi kupitila njila dina Artaires, ne kupinganayi ku moyo mu mijilu. Mijilu ya mikesa menemene badi babikila capillaire.
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Minu ya triceratops uvua ne makanda wa kukosa mabeji, nangananga kukosa mitshi minene ne miji ya mitshi.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Binga bantu ya sianse badi bela menji ne ba Triceratops bavua badia Cycades, idi mitshi ivua miaba onso mu Cretace.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Mitshi eyi idi imueneka mikesa bu mitshi ya ngaji ne mutu was miba, mabeji matangalaka.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Triceratops uvua utumikisha luminu luende bua kuvula mabeji kumpala kua kuja tshi mutshi.
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Banga bena sianse bavua bakokangana bua se mitshi ayi ivua ne lulengu, ke bankamba ne ba Dinosaurs ka bavua badia ye, bu muvua lelu nyama wa lulengu ne banyama bakuabu bu mudi nyunyi wa nkusu (ndelanganyi ya ba dinosaurs) uvua mua kudia mabeji ya lulengu anyi tshimuma.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Mushindu kayi Io's gravite udi mua ku nkoka meme? Pa udi wimana pa Io, bujitu buebe ne bushala mekesa kupita budi pa buloba.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Muntu udi ne bujitu 200 paunde (90kg) ba buloba, ne ulua ne bujitu 36 paunde (16kg) pa Io. Gravitite udi menzeja ne majitu makesa.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Munya kayi ne muaba waku imanyina bu mudi pa buloba. Munya mujima udi muenzeka ne gaz, moto, ne plasma.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Gas ne ilue mukese paudi wenda kule ne kupita mukantshi mua munya.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Tshidi tumona patudi tutangila pa munya idi ni dian photosphere mumua ni "ndundu wa moto".
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Mu bidimu binunu bisatu kupita, mu 1610, mumanyi wa malu ya mabulungu wa mu Italie Galileo Galilei uvua utumikisha teleskope bua kutangila ne Venus uvua ne bitup.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Bitupa bidi bienzeka anu ku tshimenga tshia Venus, (anyi wa Ngondo) utangila munya wela moto. Bitupa bia Venus bakitaba muyuki wa Copernicus ne mabulunge udi inyunguluka ku munya.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Bidimu kupita mu 1639, Mumanyi wa malu a mabulungu anglais Jeremiah Horrocks waka mona kupita kua Venus.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Angleterre wa kapita tshikondo tshile tshia ditalala panyima pa katshimuna yoyi Danelaw.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Pananku mu 991 Ethelred wa katuilangana ne buatu bunena ne bulepa kudi maatu onsu katshia ku Guthrum nkama ya bidimu bia mbangishilu.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Buatu ebu buvua bulombola kudi Olaf Trygvasson, muena ku Norvege ne majinga a kuangatulula ditunga diende ku bupika bua Danish.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Panyima pa basalayi aba kutuija tshilonji, Ethelred uvua ni makokeshi a kusuika mikenji ni Olaf, uvua mu pingana ku ditunga dia Norvege bua kuteta bua kuangata bukalenga buenda ni makola masambakaja.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul udi nkaya mu kuenza kua lufuabeta bua kutumikija kua matuku onso. Lufuabeta bakaluenza mu 1444, pa tshikondu tshia mukaji wa mukalenga Sejong (1418-1450).
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Mfumu Sejong uvua mfumu munayi wa nzumbu wa bukalenga wa Joseon ne uvua umwe uvua bantu bananga.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Ku mfuminu, uvua mupesha lufuabeta hangeul dina dia Hunmin Jeongeum, diumvuija "tshimbidi tshololoke bua dikela dia bantu".
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Kudi ntodi mivule bua mushindu udi Sanskrit mumueneke. Umue wabu udi wakula bua dimwangala dia Aryenne wa ku mubuelelu ku Inde, bavua balua ne makulu ewu.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskrit ewu mwakulu wa kale mu fanangana ne wa Latin mwakula mu Europa.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Mukanda wa pamutu wa kale mu bukuabisamba uvua mufunda mu mwakulu wa Sanskrit. Pashishe disangisha dia Upanishads, Sanskrit uvua mu jimina bua lua bamfumu.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sankrit ewu mwakulu wa mushindu wa dikema bikole ne mubanji, uvua tshiledibua tshlidibua tshia miakulu ya bungi ya mipiamipia ya ba Indien, yonso bu mudi Latin ewu tshiiledibua tshia miakulu ya ba europeennes bu ba français ne ba espagnol.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Ne nvita wa France ivua mujika, Allemangne wakabanga ku songakaja bua kubwela mu tshidila tshia Grand Bretagne.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Allemegne wa kapesha bulwilu ebu dina dia “Bukenji bua Sealion”. Bingoma bineme bia basalayi ba britanique ne bintu bionso bia mvita bivua bijimine pavua banyema mu Dunkerque, basalayi bavua tshitekete.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Kadi tshiluilu tshia mayi a mukalenga tshivua ne bukole kupita tshiluilu tshia bena Allemange (“Kriegsmarine”) ne tshivua mua kubutibue mayila ya nvita matuma kudi njila wa Anglais.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Kadi, mazuwa makesa a Royal Navy uvua mateka tshitaku ku butengu kua njila ivua baluishi ba lwila, bua tampatampa ivua ne buowa bua ndeke ya ba Allemande ivua bua kupuekesha mu mayi.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Tubangilayi ku tshiandamuna tshia malongoloji ya Italie. Italie uvua ntapu "mwâkunyi" wa Allemagne ne wa Japon.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Tshiotshi tshivua ne tshiluilu ne tshia mayi tshitekete, nansha bobu bakidila kuibaka mazuwa inayi kutshibangilu tshia mvita.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Tshipatshila tshia Italie tshivua matunga a mu Afrike, bua ku a kwata, bikengela apeta mwaba wa kutuma biluilu bia mvita, bua kusanbuka mu mbuwa ya mediterranee ne kubuela mu Afrike.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Bwaluabu, bavua mua kumbusha bitaku ne mazuwa a britannique mu Egypte. Pa kunsa ya dienza ma cuirasse ya ilatie ka ivua ne mudimu mukwabu.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Mpindieu bua Japon, Japon uvua didiila ditunga, mumwe ni Grande Bretagne.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Mazuwa a mwinshì mwa mayi avua mibaka bua kwenda muishi mwa mayi munda mwa dîba dile.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Mazuma a mwinshi mwa mayi avua menzesha mu tshikondo tshia mvita ya kumpala ne mibidi ya bukuamatunga. Mu tshikondo atshi avua ne lukojo mua kwenda ne kututa.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Kutshibagilu kwa mvita bavua benda pa mutu pa mbuu, kadi nasha pavua ma radara mibanga mitanda ne milwa ya mushinga mazuwa a mwishi mwa mayi owu kumbagiwu kuya mwishi ma mayi bua kabayimonyi.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Mazuwa a mwishi mwamayi a Allemagne ne dina U Boats. Ba Allemande bavua ne meeji mavula mu diendesha mazuwa a mwishi mwa mayi.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Bua mudimu muimpe ne mazuwa a mwishi mwa mayi, panyima pa mvita ba Allemande, kabena nayi ya bungi.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Eyowa mfumu Tutankhamun, mikwabu misangu mubikila "Mfumu Tut" nanyi "Mfumu Mwana Muluma", uvua umwe wa bakalenga ba kale mu Egipitu ba mania mu Tshikondo etshi.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Bidi bimpa kujadika ke kabavua ne mushinga mu Tshikondu tshiakale kabavua nansha mu mikanda ya kale ya ba Mfumu.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Nansha nanku dipeta dia lukita luenda mu 1922 diaka muenza muntu wa mutumba. Nasha muvua nkita mivuala minianga luenda luvua lushala tumatuma.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Bintu bia buni bakajika nabi Toukankhamon bivua bilamamibua bimpa, ne bimfuanyi binunu bia bienza ne biamua bia mushinga ne mabwa a mushinga.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Difuka dia kasu dia kabulwisha matimpu a bena Assiriens bua bikala ba mpepela, ne lubilu, ne pa bwimpi bua kupita bakuabu basalayi ne abu matimpu.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Miketa ya arbaleta ivua ibwela armura wa basalayi ba bilwilu bikwabu pamwe ne 1000 kumpala kua J.C ba Assyrien ba kabweja basalayi ba kumpala.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Tshiluilu tshia cavalery tshidi tshilua ku pitshila ku kabalu. Tunvi, tua tshiamu katuvua tuanji kufukibua, bena tubalu ba ku Assyrie bavua baluisha babanda pa tubalu tuabu.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Tudi bamanya ba Grec bena tshididi, bena sianse, ne bazola. Pamuapa muntu wa tshibidilu etchi avua bamanya ku ba bunyi uvua Omer, mufundi mpofo wa kale, wakenza mafundi mabidi ya difundi dia ba Grec: difundi Iliad and Odyssey.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocle ne Aristophane badi anu banji ba bikuminu ni bidimba biabu bikala bi bidimba bia malu manene a bungana.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Mukuabu muena Grec mpilu wa makumi ubikidibu ne pythagore, mene mu malanda mpakaci pa bipuapu bia nseke yisatu ne matuba asatu amulame.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Biela ngenyi bia bunyi bua bantu bakudi ba Hindi bibua bishintuluka. Tudi tuela menji bua muibidi ni muinayi muakulu, udi bantu bakula mu buloba.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Bunyi bua babadi baledibue buvua bushintuluke bilondeshile bu mudibu ba bibala enyi kumbusha muakulu wa tshisamba wa pabuipi.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Biela menji biya ku 340 ne 500 miliona bia babadi, ne ku 800 miliona ya bantu badi mua kunvua muakulu.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi ne Urdu bilambonyi mu miaku ya tshijimijilu kadi bishilanga ku miaku ya difunda; mu miyiki ya diba dionso, babadi ba miakulu yibidi bua mu kabujima mua kunvua.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Mu 15 eme ciecle, Estona wa ku nore uvua muinshi uvua nutangalaje bibidilu bia Allemagne.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Babanji bakuabu ba mu Allemagne bavua basua kuteka Nzambi hehi bantu basanganyi ne nanku benza muakulu wa kasala wa mu Estonian.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Uvua utangila pa sangilu wa maleta et ngikadilu "Õ/õ" uvuaa mukumbajija.
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Pa nyima pa diba, meyi ya bunyi miangata ku tshiena allemand mipatuka. Tshivua bangilu wa bitokeshi.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Pa tshibidilu, mu mpianyi wa nkuasa wa bukalenga uvua ubuela musagu umuepele mu busalayi kunyima kua dijikija kalasa.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Kadi, Charles wa kaya ku université ku Trinity College, ku Cambrigde; kuvuaye mulongele tulasa tua malu a sombelu ne malu a kale pashi dilonga dia malu a kale; mupeta mikanda yi bidi yi njikijilu.
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles uvua wa ku mpala wa tshisa tshia bu nfumu mu Allemagne bua kupeta mukanda wa njikijilu kalasa.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turquies wa Europa (Thrace oriental ani Roumelie mu peninsula wa Balkans) uvua bienda ne 3% wa ditunga.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Tshipapu tshia Turquie tahidi tshia 1,600 kilometa kare (1000 B) mubula ne 800 kmta (500 B) mu butshiamba ne tshifuani rectangula.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Tshipapu tshia turquie, nansha dijiba, kilometa 783,562 karre (300,948 binunu), binga kilometa kale 755,688 (291,773 Binunu ne kale) mu Asie wa kulu ne wa kwishi ne 23,764 ilometa (9,174 binunu kare) mu Europa.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Bunena bua Turquie budi mu buloba bujima udi ditunga dia 37 ku bunena, ne bunena bu bua France ne Royaume unis.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turquie munyunguluila kudi tuabukonyi pa nseke yisatu: kabukonyi Aegean ku luseke lua kudi diba dibuela, kabukonyi ka mayi Black ku node ne kabukonyi ka ku méditerranée ku side.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxembourg udi ne nsumuinu mila kadi wakapeta budikadidi mu tshidimu tshia 1839.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Dituku diva dimanyika dia mufikilu wa bena Belegi diva dituku dia mufikilu bena Luxembourg kadi lelu dikadi dilua dituku dia mufiklu wa mulamukilu mubidimu 1830.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxembourg utuamu upima kulama ngikadilu wabu wa patshiena kale kadi wakamayibua pa nviata ya kumpala ya buloba bujima ne nvita mibidi mu ditunga dia Germany.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Mu tshidimu tshia 1957 Luxembourg wakalua muibaki ne muimanyinyi wa tshisumbu tshidi tshimanyika lelu mudina dia tshisumbu tshia nsangilu wa matunga a muana wa muena Europa.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Bena Drukgya Dzong badi bamayonka mu tshitendelelu tshiabu tshia bena Buddhis tshikukuilu tshipiluka mu musoko wabena Paro ku musoko (Wabena in Phondey).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Biakudibua bua se mu tshidimu tshia 1649 Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel bakafuka tshitendelelu mu menji a tshivulukilu tshia butshimunyi buabo kumpala kua bena Tibetan-Mongol forces.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Mu tshidimu tshia 1951 muakaja anu bua tshisumbu tshia bena Drukgyal Dzongo naku bashala anu bumudi bindidimbi bia tshisumbu tshia bena Zhabdrug Ngawang Namgyal.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Kunyima ka mudilu muina tshitendelelu tshiva thikubimbua na tshilama bimpa neku kitshhiva buamua kushala tshitendelelu tshinene ne tshikukului tshia bena Bhutan.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Mu tshinkondo tshia matuku dikumi ne muanda mukulu ya bukalenge bua Cambodia bakadisangina bobo nkayabu basakilabu pankantshi pa makalenge abidi a bwena mutumba, bukalenga bua ba Thailand ne Vietnam.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Ba Thai badi babikidisha Cambodia bua se abambuluisha mu tshikondo tshia matuku 18th ni mu tshidimu tshia 1772 bakakosabo tshienzelu etshi.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Mu bidimu bia kushala panyima mu tshipilu tshia bidimu dikumi ne muanda mukulu abukalenge bua ba Vietnamien bobo pabu ba kabikidisha Combodia.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Pa bipeta dikumi ne muanda mukulu biabena Venezuela badi kabayi ne midimu ya kuenza, ni babunyi badiena benza yoyi midimu ayi badi benza midimu pa bidi bitangila malanda a budikadidi buamalu a mpetu.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Tshia bibidi ne bisatu baku venezuela badi benza mudimu batu ya ma misesu, ne pabuipi ne tshia binayi bia pa mudimu ewu mu biapu ne bivi badipabu ne muakwenza midimu mu madimi.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Tshapu tshia mushinga mukole mu venezuela ni tshiapu tshia mafuta, kimuaba utudi tusangina ditunga dikala anu diodi nkayadi didi dienza mushinga wa disumbisha mafuta, nansha momu muikale makasa makepela enzayi anu mudimu wa mafuta.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Ku ntuadijilu wa muanda menemen wa dipanda ben madimi a mitshi baku Singapore bakadi banane lungenyi bua se bashintulua eku kalaba kapankatshi pa mayi mu tshi beba tshia Tropical tshia madimi.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Mu tshidimu tshia 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, bakasungula tshibambalu tshidibu babikila ne orchid Hybrid bu tshimbambalu tshia buena ditunga bulenga.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Mu tshidimu tshionso mu ngondo wa dikumi bilongo bia kudima bikala ne miji bitua ku 1.5 milioni bitua biya ku towards mu tshipalu tshia muishi mua buloba, biobiebi bitu biya kukanga musulu udibu babikila ne Mara River, kubumkila kuluseka luakulu lua Hills bua nvula.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Tupingana kunyima kabidi mu lusaka lua kulu lua kupitshila ku West, tuya kabidi kukanga ne kuela nkila ku Mara River kunyima ku nvula ya mu ngondo muinayi.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Mu Serengeti mudi muaba kukubila Nyama baubikila ne Serengeti, muaba wakulamina nyama baubikila ne ngorongoro ne muaba wakula nyunyi ne nyama baubikila ne Maswa wowo biau ni muaba wakulamina nyama ne nyunyi muditunga dia Tanzanie ne Maasai Mara muaba udibu bakubila nyama muditunga dia kenya.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Bidi bijinga kulonga mishindu mishila shiangana yamua kukebulila ngenyi edi yende pamue ne malongesha nasha yetu ya pakala, bumudi biamua bia mudimu bienda anu bifukibua, (Mukaba wa nsumuinu, muyiki ne bikuabu.)
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Ntema yenu ne bididmbi bienu bii bileja bua se tshisuminu katshienaku to ne kakuena mushindu wutudi ne mua kulonga mudibi bijinga to.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Kufila kua ntema kudi kuleja ne mudimu udi mupeshabu kudi umue yonso, kadi udi ileja kudi umue yonso base udi mudimu udi mutapulula mu bitupa.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Dishadila dia lumuenu lua pabuipi ludi luleja ne ntema yonso ne ma numbala udi milombuibua bua kujikija mudimu kadi bidikabi bitamba buipa pamutu pa kuntuadijilu.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Ebi bidi bilua mpidiewu dishadila ku bualu bua lumuenu luakusemeja pabuipi ne mikanda yabu mikulukulu, mumushindu waku patula bipeta biakane.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Ne midimu eyi kiyakuleja bena muenu eyi ya pabuipi bua se ikale ipatula bindidimbi bia mushinga mukola mushindu umua ne bindidimbi bikulukulu bivua bifunda.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Dishadila dikuabu kuluseka lua lumuenu luapabuipi pa lukama bidi bileja (ne lubilu) lua lumuenu bu pamatuku onso.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Ebi bidi bibandisha mushinga wa lumuenu elu ludi lukoka bindidimbi pabuipi ne ludi luikala ne lutatu pa kumuna paudi kuyi ne bukenka bukola to.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Bumua bua ku maalu atu afika pa diteta dia kukudimuna tshimdidimbi kutshienza mmumushindu wa DVD budi nditentula.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Television yabungi mienza mu mushindu wa kusankisha babandidi.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Bua bualu abu, bionso biudi umona ku bindidimbi bivua ne ndekelu yabi mikosolola mu tshitupa tshia kulu, tshia kuinshi ne bia kumpenga.
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Tshienza nunku bua se bindidimbi bikala bitua ku mibangubangu ya lumuenu lujima. Tshidi tshibikidibua se ditentula.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Kabiyi nangu, Paudi ukuata bimdidimbi bia DVD, ndekelu yabi neyikala ne buakuikala mikosa kabidi, ni bimdidimbi biobi bikala ne mifundu pabuipi ne mibangubangu ya kuinshi, mifundu eyi ki ya kumueneka mu bujima buayi nansha.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Castle wa kabukulu wa bikondo bia kala mukoka ntangidilu, muzola bimfuanyi bia nvita, biadidi ni Arthurian chivalry.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Nansha bimana mungatshi mua bidimu tshinunu bia tshinyangu, bidi bipepele bua kuteka mu meji mitoyi ni mipuya ya nvita mipita kala, bafuanyika kunvua ne mitoyi ya bikonu pa bibumba ni kunvua mupuya wa powa ifumina mu kazubu ka lupepela ka kundekelu wa etage.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Kadi diela meji dietu ndifumina ku maalu apanu anyi? Bua tshinyi nzubu mialabala ivua mibaka mu miaba ya kumpala? Mushindu kayi uvu bayizola ni bayibaka?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Bua tshikondo, Kirby Muxloe Castle udi nzubu mukole mupita Castle.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Madidishi ende a madilekela ne tubimanu tukesa atu kavua ukumbana mua kukandamena bihuhu bikole ntanta mule.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Avua Mukelenge Hastings mubanga ku muibaka, mu tshidimu tshi 1480, ditunga divua ne ditalala ne bavua baluangana anu ne kasumbu kakese ka bimvi bavua ba banda baweka.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Tshipimu tshia bukola bua tshiapu tshiva bulongolodi bua matunga aba katenda mutoka mutshiadi neku kulepeja lungenyi buakukuba biakana ne kulama bukalenga bua bena Sovereignty bua bena europa mukabujima.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Tshiena bualu tshiva buase europa mujima uva usama ne baleja bua se tudi ditunga didi diluila kubukole butamba bunene ne bukalenga ebu butu bushintulula misangu yonso malanda abu mubulongame bua kukuba biakane manema abu.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Nvita ya bena Spanish yakalondela nvita yakumpala tshinabualu menemene tshiva anu bukalenga buva bushala.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Etshi tshia kaleja nshidimukilu munene, bumudi matunga a Europa kabena kabidi mua kuikala ne bukole bua kulonda tshienzelu tshia bitendelelu bia nvita. Etshi ntshidimu thia makumi asatu tshidi tshia ndekelu bua malu abitendelelu bia nvita.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Tshitendelelu tshia Artemis ku Ephesus wupudi nzubu mu ngondo wa muandamutekete mu matuku makumi abidi ne dimue, 356 BCE mu tshibadi tshia tshipalu tshia ndeka.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Bilondeshela lusuuinu, makanda enda onso adi anu adima kumushinga yonso. Bena Ephesians, nekanyinganyinga kamanyika ne Herostratus mudina dia kubenga kufiatulula mukaba.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Muedi wa nsumuinu Greek Strabo muikala mudina edi, mumushindu wutudi bamanya leluewu. Tshitendelelu etshi tshiva tshiupulabu anu mubutuku bumuebumue abu buakalelabu Alexander muakane.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexander, udi bunfumu mufila bua kufuta ne kuibakulula bitanda, kadi midimu yende yonso iva mipetula. Kunyima kua lufu lua Alexander tshitabda tshiva tshibakulula mu 323 BCE.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Umanya bimpa bua se diboko dieba didi diteketa ne dimpa mudiba diwudi ukuata mifundu bimpa, ne utetaku kukuata minu yeba bimpa.
eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Mu mushindu ewu newupima wewa nkayeba mushindu wakuepuka tumua tua tuana tua malu. Uvuluka bua ne kabiena anu bilomba kukuata anu nsampi ne lonji luabunyi bumudi tshiamua tshia buimbi tshia mbote.
eng_text: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Mudiba dia buimbi mushindu buakupeta diyi dia kulu, udi muakuenzela mbote ya panshi kuyi kuma ne makanda ne lukasa lukasa.
eng_text: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Majimbu adi alonda nsangilu ne mena ne batuishibua ne bimua bilejelu bilelela bia mpepela ya nyuma ya Nzambi mulelela.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Bitabi badi basama kumanya mianda ne malu malelela, anyi mukubuelabu mu bipidi biakulu bilelela anyi bia mafi.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Balondi badi balonda ne bakeba njila yakupatukila, biabi kuenzela ebi bidi bindila buakuleja dimanya kudi bakuabu.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Buena nyuma mbushilangana ne mishindu mikuabu ya ntendelelu ne masambila bualu idi itangila bikola malu adi muntu mudi muene ne mesu ende ngaya a mukondu kende ka moyo, nanga nanga bia ditalala, meji, disanga, eshi tshienzedi tshia disanga menemene.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikhism ntendelelu udi mu mbukila ku luseka lua Asiewa ku butshika. Utu mubangila mu Punjab mu lukonga lua 15 ku mukila matahuluki mungatshi mua kabukulu ka bena Hindu.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Batendelediba ba Sikh badi badi mona ne mbashiangana ne ndeleledi wa bena Hindu nansha mudibu bitabuja se bienzedi ne miji yabo miumukila kudi bena Hindu.
eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Ba tendeledi ba Sikhs batu ba bikila ntendeledi wabu ne Gurmat, muena kuamba mu muakulu wa bena Punjab ne "nyila wa bu nzambi". Bu nzambi mushindi wa menemenewa ntendeledi yonso ya bena India kadi ba tendndeledi ba Sikh ba bianganta bia mushinga mukole too ne bikadi bilua ditabuja diabu dia menemene.
eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Ntendelelu wak kafukibua mu lukonga lua 15 kudi mulongeshi wa malu a nyuma ba mubikila ne Nanak (1469- 1539). Ne kulondela ba longeshi ba nyuma bakuabu tshitema.
eng_text: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Mu ngondo muisambombo tshidimu tshia 1956 milayi ya Krushchev's ivua mi tetshibua avua bimvundu bijuka mu ditunga dia Poland, avua benji ba midimu bajuka bua diakudia tshikesa ne dikosa dia makuta mu difutu, bia kalua bimvudu bivua bibenga mushindu wa communisme.
eng_text: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Nansha muvu Krushchev wa katuma bingoma mua kualuja bulongama, kadi kundekelu wa kitaba ku malombi a bantu ne kuteka munangibua kudi bantu Wladyslaw Gomulka bu minister wa kumpala.
eng_text: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Dishidimuka dia Indus Valley divua dishidimuka dia tshikondo tshia biamu ku tshiha tshia kulu dia kudi diba dibuelela ku luseka lua India bikala mu buena lelu ehu muaba munene waa ditunga dia Pakistan ne miaba ya ku luseka lua kulu kudi diba dibuelela mu ditunga dia India ne kulu dia kudi diba dibueela mu ditunga dia Afghanistan.
eng_text: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Dishidimuka divua dibanda bikola mu miaba ya musula wa Indus ke kudi dina diadi difumina.
eng_text: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Nansha mudi balongi ba mukanda bakuabu bamba se bu muvua dimanya edi dibangila pamuaba wa musulu ukadi muma mu manya mu dina dia musulu wa Sarasvati, Udi ukengela kubikidibua ne dishidimuka dia Indu-Sarasvati, bakuabu badi ba mubikila ne dishidimuka dia Harappan kumukila ku Harappan, umua wa pa miaba yayo ya kumpala ku diumbudibua mu bidimu bia 1920.
eng_text: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Masalayi a midima abena Roman bakambuluisha mumushindu wa kuya kumpala ne londapu.
eng_text: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Baminganga kutuadijabu midimu kubulombodi bua mukalenge munene Augustus ne kuenzayi tshisumbu tshinene tshia bondapi ne bua bakuata mudimu mu tshikondo tshia mulongo wa baluanganyi.
eng_text: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Surgeons wakapeta lungenyi ne kubandayi lonji pamue ne morphine bilondeshela kutuadija dia poppy seeds ne scopolamine kumbukila kudi herbaneseeds.
eng_text: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: bakaluabu ne thibidilu tshia kulamabu babedi bilondeshela Gangreen momumue ne Tournique ne rterial clamps bua kusambuka mashi akadi apueka panshi.
eng_text: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Kumpala kua biluilui bia siècle babena Roma, bukalenge bua kalombola mumushindu wa manga abukole bua mubidi ne kuasabu ngenyi ya bungi ne itudi bashala bamanya too ne lelu.
eng_text: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Buloba bulelela bua bena origami ne manema abu ne mikanda yabu adimuakujikijibua mu diba dimue, mikanda yabungi idi ipingana kabidi kunyima bualu bua se imue mikanda kayena mitabujibua to, mivula idi mikale ne makanda abungi nemanema makole mu bibidi biabu.
eng_text: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Biakadi bishidimuna kudi Jhon smith mu tshidimu tshia 1970 mumushindu wa kuambuluisha bamue bakadi ne amue mapanga a ngenyi mu biamua biabu biajaja.
eng_text: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Bana bakashidimuka ngenyi ya mamanya ne kushituluka kua meyi abu nsonga ne ebi bintu bishintula bikadilu.
eng_text: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Bua mu tshipidi emu bana badi bajingulula manema makese adi mikala a mushindu mukumbana badi kabayi balonga anyi badikabayi balonga bimpe badimbu babambila malu abisumbu bia stereotype ne makoba amibidi yabu.
eng_text: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace udi muisata ku ma website adi bantu babunyi benzela mu United statesne ne pindiewu udi ni ngumu ya bantu 54 milio.
eng_text: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Websites eyi mipeta ditabelela dia bunyi, nanga nanga mu dilongolola dia malongesha.
eng_text: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Kudi bilegelu bimpa bua websites eyi, idi isangisha, kuikala ne bukokeshi bua kulongolola dibeji dia mu internet dia kalasa bipepele idi mua kusangisha kabidi website ya miyuki, bimdidimbi, bimfuanyi, ne bikuabu bintu.
eng_text: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Dibeji dia mu internet edi didi dikumbana kubuela momu bipepele mu difila dia web address, kitshidi tshimuenza bipepele bua kuvuluka ne bipepele bua kufunda bua balongi badi mua kuikala ni lutatu bua kuenzela mbota anyi kutela maleta.
eng_text: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Udi ukumbana kuikala kushintulula bua ku muenza mupepele bua dibala ne makala a disua dietu kabidi.
eng_text: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Ntema idi yumbusha dilekelela "udi muikalangane tshimue tshimanyinu tshia kupanga kukumbaja majinga ne uleja butekete, kuikala dibuutu anyi kukuikala ne butekete anyi kujimija makanda".
eng_text: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Kinkulonga buteketa to, kadi nkulonga dilekelela mu kupanga bukalanga, bidi "ne tshipumbisha kudi tunungu 3 anyi 5 tua bana mu bulaba bujima anyi pa millio 2 ya bana ba mu ditunga dia Amerika".
eng_text: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Baa badi ne ADD badi ne lutatu ne kupanga kua diba dia kukuata tulasa tua midimu ya bianza, badi bikala basaka ne kumuna bididimbi bia tuana tunaya anyi bazaba manaya amu biamua anyi bafunta biambilu bufundavi kabiyi banemeka tutoba ne tukosolu to.
eng_text: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Bana aba badi panjuwu yabungi buakumuna "bikadilu biabu bidi bikala balunganyisha ban nfumu banene" ne kubela mitshi mu njila, buakubapangiha mushindu wabobo kukuata yabu midimu ne kakuena kabidi mushindu waku baluija mu njila muakane to.
eng_text: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: ADD udi ukuata miimu pa malunda amananga adi mubana lelu ne bana kabena ne lunvu to ne kabena bunva pabidibu benza ne kabena bamuna mushindu udibu bikala ne nansha ngelelu wabu wa menji.
eng_text: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Bumudi tshiena bualu tshia kukuata dimanya ne kulonga kushintuluka bumudibi biamba kumuntu ekune ngenyi ya bena banshi anyi bena lutatu yakashituluka mu tshipidi kayi.
eng_text: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Pa kujindula ngumu kuakadi dishilangana. Kakuyi kabidi nansha kuvuluija ngana to pankayetu kadi tshikadilu tshia mua kuvuluija ngana kukadi kuikala kutuma ntema.
eng_text: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Mu essence, bena mutshikondu tshia bena lelu tshidi tshiunvuija kushidimuka kua ndngamu ne kuakaja lungenyi.
eng_text: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Buvakabiyi nansha binanga binga bijikila ne matuku, ba hominidé wakadi katshiyi kabidi wenzela bianza biende to mu biapatshibidilu ne ukepesha bujitu anyi kulembelela ku mitshi.
eng_text: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Tshima biende bianza anyi makasa adi afanangana kubunene ne bule, ne aleja tshifanyi shia mudimu wa bianza waku tshibula nawu bujitu mu kuenda kua kutewula.
eng_text: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Bianza bia bantu bidi bipi pakuidikija ne makasa nansaha ne minu yabu ya tshiala milola.
eng_text: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Midimu ya bianza mikole mu bidimu mbombu ne mbombu biakashidimuna midimu pa dimanya dipiluka dia mashinyi manene akutua minunu ne akuata mudimu.
eng_text: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Bkuabu bantu badi bamane kudimanya ne bamanya mushindu wakukudimuka nayi mushindu wakulota ne ka tshilota kakese kadi muakuikala kamuvuluija.
eng_text: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Kabingila kanene ka tshiena bualu etshi tshidi tshipetu tshia tshilota tshia patoka kumesu tshileja bule bua diba pankatshi pa katupa ka bulaba ka REM.
eng_text: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Ne REM mukese pa butuku bonso, mu muaba anyi ditunga diwudi ulala ne unva bua se mubidi weba udi kauyi mutuwu to kakese bidi bilua bualu.
eng_text: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Etshi tshidi tshikala mumue ne mushindu uwutu ujuka ulonda bindidimbi ku TV mu tususa makumi baidi nayi makumi asatu.
eng_text: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Bimanyinu ebi bidi bilondeshela muwudi wibidija mutu weba ne kibidi bileja bilota bitoke munda mua butuku.
eng_text: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Malu ki menda bimpa to bua bena ku Italie mu Africa wa Kumutu pamuepela ne kumbangidi. Munkatshi mua lumingu lua dîyi dikole dia mvita dia ditunga dia Italie mu matuku 10 a gondo Muisambombo, 1940, muena mu ditunga dia Britannique wa 11 Hussars wa kangata bukokeshi mu Fort Capuzzo ku Libye.
eng_text: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Mu dibutshikila dia ku Est wa Bardia, Bena Britannique bakakuata mulombodi mutumbuke wa dimanya ditue Lastucci uvua muikala ulombola tshisumbu tshia Dikumi tshia biluilu bia mvita tshia ku Italie.
eng_text: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Mu 28 wa ngodo Muisambombo, Marshal Italo Balbo, mulombodi mutumbuke wa mu ditunga dia Libye ni mumpianyi uvua ku Mussolini, uvua mushebeya kudi midilu mikese pavuaye wikila mu Tobruk.
eng_text: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Manayi a buena lelu adibu ba bikila ne fencing adi anayibua mu bihidi bishilangana, kubangila ku balonyi ba tulasa tu tumbuka to ne ku benzi ba mudimu ne manayi a Olympic.
eng_text: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Manayi aha tshia kumpala mpala adi anayibua kudi bantu ba bidi, umua ukuatangana ne mu kuabu.
eng_text: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Golf ndi nayi didi ba nayi benzela mitshi mua kututa ndundu abuela mu mena.
eng_text: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Masosu dikumi ne muanda mukulu adi anayibua mu dinayi dia kumpala, ne banayi batu nangananga ba banga ku disosu dia kumpala ne bajikijila mu dia dikuumi ne muanda mukulu.
eng_text: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Munayi udi wangata to ndundu tukesa, eshi dikoha dia mutshi, mua kujikija ke udi utshumuna.
eng_text: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Dinayi didi di nayibua mu mashinda, ne mashinda adi abuipi ne disosu makosa mashiya a tshituha ne abikidibua se the green.
eng_text: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Amuaha mushindu udi mumanyika bikola wa luendu lua ku tangila udi tshidi bantu ba sambakaja ne luendu: Luendulua ku di sulakaja.
eng_text: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Ebi mpadi bantu baya pa muaba udi mushilangana ne miaba yabo ya tshibidilu mua kuikisha ne ku naya.
eng_text: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Miaba ya kumpenga kua mayi, ne miaba ya manayi ke miaba ya yitu bantu ba bunyi baya mua kanaya.
eng_text: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Ikala shiena bualu tshia muntu kuya pa muaba kampanda mbbua ku manya malu akala au ne bienzedi nengu ewu mushindu wa luendu ewu badi ba wubikila ne luendu lua ku longa bienzedi.
eng_text: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Bendakanyi badi mua kuya pa miaba mishilangana ya tshishiki mu ditunga ka mpanda eshi badi mua ku sungula mua kutangila anu muaba umue tshianana.
eng_text: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Bakuatshianganyi ba ku buhika, bamona mudimu eu, ne ba ku bikila dia mbuluisha.
eng_text: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Bisumbu bia masalyi bivua bikolesha muaba wa kumpala ne tshisumbu tsia kumpala ne tshisatu tshia masalayi a New Hampshire a bantu 200 muinshi mua ba kolonela ba masalayi John Stark ne James Reed (bonso bakala ba general ba masalayi).
eng_text: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Masalayi a Stark avua ku mikalu dia kulu lua kundekelu kua muaba wa kuatshianganyi ba ku buhika.
eng_text: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Adi divuala dia kuishi dikangula ohamua musulu wa Mystic ohamua dia kulu dia kulu luseka lua kudi diba di atukila ku kahesa ka bulaba, pa lukasa ba ku lehesha lupangu ne "short stone wall" lu kuya ku dia kulu lua ku muntu kua mayi mu muaba udibu ba bikila ne small beach.
eng_text: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley ne Stark bavua bateka tshituwa dia mutshi pa ntanta wa (30m) kumpala kua luhangu ne ne bela mukandu wa se musalayi nansha umue kashi to tii ne adi ba regulars ba tshipita.

eng_text: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

eng_text: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Ne dishintuluka dia ku tshimua tshia binayi kuya ku ngatshingatshi wa ntanta wa luendu, lubilu ke ndua mujinga kabidi to ne dinanukila dikadi dia mushinga.
eng_text: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Bulelela munyemi wa ntanta wa ngatshingatshi wa kumpala, muntu udi ututa tusunsa tubidi, bikengela ikala ne lubilu lukumbana, kadi mbimpa ikala ne dikandamana muu njiwu yonso.
eng_text: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Disambuluka dia mu ma tunga mu tshikondo tshia mashika, ohamue ne kunayisha mubidi kudi kua mbuluisha bituha bia kulu, kemusindu muimpa wa kudilongolola bua tshikondo tshia lubilu.
eng_text: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Mishinduu mimpe ya tshia kudia ngayayi keyena mua kufuka makanda adi akengedibua to, kadiidi mua kuambuluisha ba atelete ba bana mu mishindu yonso.
eng_text: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Mua kulama makanda adi akumbana, tshienzedi tshimpa kudiboleshane mayi, ne kumanya mishindu mikuabu ya kudi kumbajisha idi mu kuambuluisha ateleta ne kubandisha ngazedi wenda wa manayi.
eng_text: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Bintu bidi mua kusumbibua mudi bilombibua, kadi bia bunyi ne bikala ne kakesa etshi kabiyi ne dikuatshisha pa ngenzedi.
eng_text: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Ba Athlète badi mua kujinga tshintu nansha tshiotshi katshiyi ne dikuatshisha dia nsongu.
eng_text: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Atoma utu muenza bunyi ke madiotu adi mibaka tshintu tshionsu.
eng_text: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Ntshintu tshinene bikola tshidi ne, bilondeshela mushindu wa Bohr, musa mungatshi munyunguluka kudi electrons, bifuanangana ne mudi ma planeta anyunguluka ku diba - tangila tshimfuanyi 1.1.
eng_text: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Musa udi ne bintu bibidi - neutrons ne protons.
eng_text: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Protons idi ne nzembu ya positif ne neutrons kayena ne nzembu to. Electron idi ne nzembu ya negatif.
eng_text: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Bua kutangila badi batahika, bidi bikengela utangila muaba udi bualu buenzekela bua kudi lama.
eng_text: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Bidi bikengela utangila pamuaba udi mutahika pa udi wenda uya kudiyi ne njuwu yonso idi mua kuhatukila.
eng_text: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Wewa mupetakana ne njiwu mudiabuluisha bakuabu, udi panu muenza bua kukolesha malu.

text: Malonga avua mapeta se diela dia meji, bowa ne kunyanga kudi akatshi a bululu ne bulema kudi bantu badi basama nyima.
eng_text: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Badi mu bienzedi bia matuku onsu badi ba lomba dikuatshisha dia bunyi ku bidi bitangila muenedi mubi wa bu lulu mua ku sungulula bululu bua ntanta mula ne diumvua bibi bia kumbukila midimu ya mubidi.
eng_text: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Dimona, eshi bukokeshi bua ku mona bidi bilondeshela mushindu wa mijilu ya mesu.
eng_text: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Kudi mishiindu ya bunyi ya mesu, bilondeshela mishindu ya mubidi.
eng_text: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Mishindu mishilashilangana idi ne bukokeshi bushilangana, bidi ne mavuala ne buimpa bushilangana, kabidi bidi bilombibua njila mishishilangana mua ku tshintshika dibuela ne bunyi bua midimu mishilashilangana.
eng_text: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Bungana ntshisumbu tshia bantu tshidi tshiswika diyi, pa muaba kampanda.
eng_text: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Tshikondo tshikala muntu yonso munda mua tshisumbu anyi mu kabunganyi ne bua kutangilayi bualu bonso ne mesu abobumue ku tshiena bualu kampanda anyi kasanga, bi ne bimanyinka bune Monomorhic.
eng_text: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Padi tshisumbu tshia bantu tshilenja kubandisha kua lonji, bilondeshela mushindu udibu babalombola ebi badi babikila ne Polymorphic.
eng_text: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Tshisumbu tshia masalayi ne bena dishidimuna dia bena ditunga mumushindu wa dishilangana dia bibadi bu patshibidilu.
eng_text: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Mu tshipidi tshia nomadic, tshisumbu thia bena nvita tshitu tshikuata midimu butuku ne mukambi tshimanyika midimuyabu munda munya.
eng_text: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Bena ditunga ne dishidimuka dia ditunga bakatuadija ne bena nomadic ne munda mua tshikondo etshi bashidimukiji ba ditunga bakatuadija dishintuluka dituku dionso.
eng_text: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Muntu yonso wabena nomade utu uluangana nvita ya panshi anyi yakuenda bidibu popamue ne matuku 17.
eng_text: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Cell ntshinyi? Muaku Cell udi uluila ku muakulu wabena latin udibu babikila ne "cella", tshimanyisha kuamba nee "kazubu kakese", ne kakadi ajandula kudi batangidi banene ba bibambalu bia bena cork.
eng_text: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Tshiambilu etshi Cell tshidi tshimanyisha ndongamu wa bukua bintu ne bungana buabi popamue ne bisumbu bia bungi bua ma cellule.
eng_text: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Ma cellule udi munene ne manema abungi ne udi mushikamina pa kulonga nsombelu, ne udibu muakuikala batupinganyina ne kuebeja mushindu kayi uudi "muakuibaka manema a ngikadilu".
eng_text: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Mijilu ya mutu idi ilama himeostasis kudituma dia dilama lubilu lua mashi bu patshibidilu.
eng_text: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Mijilu eyi idi ituma ne londapu lu ludi lulama mubidi ne ne luambuluisha kudikuba dia mubidi ku makanda onso adikuba.
eng_text: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Tornadoes ka tshibeba kakese kad kinkla ne thipepela tshia bungi ne nkuba mikola, kadi kabayi mua kubumbula mabanji abu to.
eng_text: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Tardoes wakulu pa bisatu udi ne ubukula bibambalu ne ubukisha mashinyi ne mitoto. Tshipepela tshikola tshiva ne tutupa tubidi pa lukama kadi tshikala ne meba asatu.
eng_text: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Nkuba ne mpepela ya dialu ibanda too ne 480km/h (133 m/s; 300mph).
eng_text: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Bantu bakenze ngendu ya kumanyisha malu aaa ne kufunda mikanda misangu mivulu pa tshinunu tshia bidimu.
eng_text: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Bushuwa, tshiamua tshilelela tshia telescope tshia kumpala tshiakadi tshienza mu ditunga dia Europa mu matuku 16th a century.
eng_text: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Tshiamua etshi tshi telescope tshiakadi tshienza kudi biapua bibidi mu ngelelu wa menji wa kuleja dishilangane dia bintu kubunene ne bule.
eng_text: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Dialakana ne didisua ne bikala nau netu mu tshikondo tshionsu, ne netuikala anu mu malunda ne bapetshi ba diambuluisha ne bikala ba bungi ne ni basanka mu tshikondo tshipi ne nibikala badisuila.
eng_text: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Batuishibua ne bantu ba bungi ne bamanya bua se tshikondo tshiotshi tshilepa ne kuikala badi muakuitabuja kukuata midimu ne bakuabu.
eng_text: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Bantu babunyi batu balota dituku diaya bantu ku mutoto mukuabu ni dia jendula maloba makuabu, bantu bakuabu badiebeja bidi kuaka bakuabu bamba ni kudi ba extraterrestre anyi bifukibue bikuabu pa dibulunge dikuabu.
eng_text: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Kadi, nansha biobio bienzeke kabiena kuenzeka kumpala kua tshikondo tshile kupita. Mitoto mmitangalake ni kudi kilometre mbombu ni mbombu munkatshi mua mitoto idi "pabuipi".
eng_text: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Pakuabu dinga dituku, ba nkanunuina bebe ni bimane pa buloba bua ba extraterrestre bavuluka ba nkambu babu?
eng_text: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Nyama idi ni ma cellule abunyi, badi badia bintu ni babimina munda. Nyama ya bunyi idi mua kumbuka pa muaba ni kuya pa mukuabu.
eng_text: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Anu nyama ki itu ni bongo (nansha kabiyi yonso; ma medize, pa tshilejelu, kayitu ni bongo).
eng_text: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Nyama itu pa buloba bujima. Itu yumbula mu buloba, yowela mu mbuwa, ni ibuka mulu.
eng_text: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Celile nkatupa kakese ni ka katumikisha ka bujima ka (tshintu) muntu wa moyo.
eng_text: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Celile ndina diluile ku Latin cella nimuni kuamba ni nkazubu kakese.
eng_text: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Wewe mutangile tshifukibua tsha moyo mu microscope, ni umune ni tshidi tshenza ni tuzubu tukese anyi tu ndundu.
eng_text: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hook, biolojiste wa mu Angleterre, kumuna yi tuzubu tukese mu tshizubu ni microscope.
eng_text: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Bidi bu tuzubu. Uvua wa kumpala kumuna ma celile mafue.
eng_text: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Ma eleman ni ma bintu bisanga bidi mua kudi kudimuna kadi kabiyi bishuntuluka to.
eng_text: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Azote bu gaz udi mufuanangane ni Azote wa mayi. Eta likide udi mushitakane kadi ma molekule kaena ashuntuluka.
eng_text: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Mayi ntshilejelu tshikuabu. Mayi adi menza ni idrojene ibidi ni atome umue wa oxijene.
eng_text: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Udi ni molecule wa mo mumuenansha biobio bikale lupepela, mayi, anyi bia bikole.
eng_text: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Eta wende fizike udi mua kushuntuluka, kadi eta wende chimike udi wa mo mumue.
eng_text: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Diba ntshintu tshidi tshitu nyunguluka, ni tshikuata bionso bitudi tuenza, kadi bidi bikole bua tuetu kumvua.
eng_text: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Diba divua dilonga kudi bena nzambi, bena menji, bena mukanda kukadi bidimu biabunyi.
eng_text: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Tudi tumuna diba bu mulongo wa bintu bia malaba biya mu makelela bipitshila mu lelu.
eng_text: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Diba didi kabidi mutudi tumuna bunyi (bule) bua malu.
eng_text: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Udi mua kufunda diba didi dipita nkayebe mu kutangila malu adi anyunguluka mu tshijengu. Malu adi anyunguluka ntshintu tshidi tshenzeka kabidi ni kabidi ni misangu yonso.
eng_text: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Ordinatere lelu idi yambuluisha ku zaba ni bindidimbi bia ma foto ni bia ma video.
eng_text: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Animasion ya pabuayi idi mua kuenzekela pa ordinatere, ni animasion ya nunku badi ba yela mu televizion ni ma film.
eng_text: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Misambu batu bayi kuata ni ordinatere ya pabuayi bua kuenza ni kuteka meyi pamue.
eng_text: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Kale mu XIXe ni XXe siecle, bavua bele menji ni bantu ba kumpala mu nouvelle-Zelande bavua ba Moari, bavua bakuate nyunyi munene uvua ubikidibua moas.
eng_text: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Malonga wowo kuleja ni ba Moari bavua bumbuke mu Polynesie mu tshibunyi ni bobo kuangata Nouvelle-Zelande mu Moriori, ni bobu kuibaka kasumbu ka badimi.
eng_text: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Kadi, bujadiki bupiabupia buleja ni ba Moriori bavua tshisumbu tsha ba Moari bavua bumbuke mu Nouvelle-Zelande kuya ku Chatham Island, bobo kutantshisha madimi abu apabuawu, a mu lutulu.
eng_text: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Kuvua kabidi tshisamba tshikuabu mu Chatham island ba Maori bavua bunbukile mu Nouvelle-Zelande.
eng_text: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Kudibikila bu ba Moriori kuvua tu nvita tua tukese ni ku ndekelu, ba Moriori kutshimunyibua bu.
eng_text: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Bantu bavua batela kukadi bidimu biabunyi bipite bavua batuambuluishe kuanyisha bu makanda etu ni dinanga diba dituvua mu dikenga ni bakuluke mene.
eng_text: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Mu kunvua bantu bela tusumuinu tuabu nkayabu, tua diku, ni tua malongolola, tuvua bapete dimona dia bivua bipite ni bantu banene bavua benze bua bibi ni bimpe bifike mu culture wa dilongolola.
eng_text: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Nansha ni kunvua lusumuinu nki kunvua kulture, bivua biambuluishe bantu bapete lunvu lua muaba wabu mu lusumuinu lua bulongolodi.
eng_text: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Mu ku tata ditanta ni mu kudimuka pa kudi shinda, bantu ni bonso bavua bapitshile mu bajendula mu ndondo bujitu, tshena bualu ni makole a bulongolodi.
eng_text: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Nunku, kuvuluja kua bintu bia buenji bua mudimu bia kale ni ditanta divua diluile ku bivua biambuluishe bantu bua kudiunzulula ku nshuntulukilu mipiamipia bu eklezia wa mu ditunga.
eng_text: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Nsumuinu ya nunku ya ditanta ivua miumbushe bowa bua kushuntuluka, mifile bumonyi buimpe bua dishuntuluka mu matuku a kumpala.
eng_text: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Diela dia meji edi didi mushindu wa kusangisha ngenyi mishilashilangana bua kupeta bipeta ku malu adibu basangidibue.
eng_text: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Tshidi batekela meji muaba umua mbua lubilu, didinemeka ne ndudi, bua dijandula dia bulelela, kuenzulula technique ikadi mikalangana koku, sangilu ya ngumu.
eng_text: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Bualu bua mushinga mukola mu diteka meji kaba kamua: kudi anu diandamuna dimue dilelela. Udi wela meji bua mandamuna abidi, abikidibua se dimanya anyi dipanga.
eng_text: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Mushindu ewu wa diela meji udi musangisha ni malongesha eshi mishindu mikuabu mialabala.
eng_text: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Bantu badi ne mushindu ewu wa diela meji badi ni diela dia meji dijalama, badi ne bukokeshi bua kukuata ku moyi miaku, kufila bipeta ku malu ne kuenza mudimu mu mateta a malongesha.
eng_text: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Bantu mbifukibua bia lungenyi lule bua kubala mu mitu ya bakuabu.
eng_text: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Etshi tshunvuija ne tudi bakunbane bua kuamba tshidi bakuabu bamuna, bela menji, bitaba, bamanye anyi bajinge.
eng_text: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Mu nkatshi bukole ebu, kunvua tshidi bakuabu basua kuenza kudi ku dijinga. Kudi kutuambuluisha kunvua malu a mubidi.
eng_text: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Tshilejelu, wewe mumune muntu upanda lumuenu lua mashini, ni wele menji ni pakuabu uvua ukeba kuiba mashini abende.
eng_text: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.
