text: Ni bishountuluke ni uvua mujimije nsapi yende ni bivua mu mashini ende muvua yi utete kubuela mu kupanda.
eng_text: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: IRM utu umbukila ku tshidi bu babikila Rezonance manyetik nukleyere (RMN), uvua mupeta mu 1930 kudi Felix Bloch (utumika ku Stanford University) ni Edward Purcell (umbukila ku Harvard University).
eng_text: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Mu rezonance ewu, champ manyetik ni ma onde radio bifila atome ku dipatula tu meyi tukese tua radio.
eng_text: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Mu 1970, Raymond Damadian, munganga ni mukebi muena mukanda, kupeta yi mua kutumikija imagerie kupitshila rezonance manyetik bu tsha kuteta natshi mu bondapi.
eng_text: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Bidimu binayi pashishe bobo kufila mukanda, divua dia kumpala pa buloba mu bidi bitangila IRM.
eng_text: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Mu 1977, Dr. Damadian kujikija yi dienza dia “skanere” wa mubidi mujima wa kumpala, uvua ye mubikile ”Katshiyi kutshimuna”.
eng_text: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Miyiki ya asenkrone idi ifila diba dia kuela menji ni diandamuna ku bakuabu.
eng_text: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Idi ipesha balongi bukole bua kuenza mudimu mudibu basue ni kutangila luendu lua bidi bitangila malongesha.
eng_text: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Bikuabu, kudi dikosa dia meba dikese ni mushindu wa kushuntula meba a mudimu. (Bremer, 1998).
eng_text: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Ditumikija dia internet ni dia World Wide Web didi dituma balongi ku kupeta ngumu diba dionso.
eng_text: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Balongi badi kabidi mua kutuma nkonko ku balongeshi diba dionso ni bindila mandamuna a pa lukasa, pamutu pa kuindila too ni ku reunion mukuabu wa mpala ku mpala.
eng_text: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Mushindu mupia mupia wa dilonga udi ufila dipanda dia kadiyi ni ndekelu. Kakuena mushindu muimpe bua kulonga.
eng_text: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Bulelela, kakuena tshintu tshimpe tsha kulonga. kulonga kudi kuenzeka mu bidi bienzeka pankatshi pa mulongi ni dimanya didibu bamupesha.
eng_text: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Bipeta bietu bia mpidiewu ni ma emission onso a televizion adi akuila pa dilonga ni bia kudienzela bidi bileja bintu ebi.
eng_text: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Babunyi mu nkatshi muetu batu batangila ma emmission a television adi afila ngumu ya kuenza anyi bintu bitudi katuyi mua kuenza anyi kumanya.
eng_text: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Katuena mua kubangulula mashinyi, anyi kuibaka tsha kupatula mayi mu budimi, kuya kuendakana mu Peru bua kulonga bishadila bia kale, anyi kushuntula nzubu wa mwena mutumba.
eng_text: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Kupitshila bulungi bua nshinga ya mu mayi ku Europe ni kupitshila ma satelite, Groenland udi mulunga bimpe ni bantu %93 badi batumikija enternete.
eng_text: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Hotel webe anyi muakididi (padiyi usombela mu tshaka benyi any nzubu wa nkayende) ni ikale ni wifi anyi ordinatere muasa ku enternete, ni miaba yonso idi ni cyber kafe anyi miaba mikale ni wifi wa bantu bonso.
eng_text: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Bumudibi biambibwe kumutu, nansha mudi dina "Eskimau" dishala ditabibue mu Etats-Unis, dika dipetudibwe kudi babungi badi kabayi ba mu Etats-Unis ba mu Arctique, nangananga mu Canada.
eng_text: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Nansha wewe munvua ba mu Greenlandic batumikisha edji djina, ba mu matunga menyi badji ni tcha kuepuka.
eng_text: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Badji baledjibue mu djitunga djia Groenland batubadjibikila Inuit mu Canada ni mu Kalaalleq (kutshibunyi Kalaallit), muena mu Groenland, mu Groenland.
eng_text: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Bushipiangani ni dilama dibi dia benyi, kabiena mu Groenland to. Nansha mu bimenga, kamuena "miaba ya mikole to."
eng_text: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Mashika ki pakuabu njuwu imue idi udi kayi mu dilongolole mua kupeta.
eng_text: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Wewe muye mu Greenland diba dia mashika (mu wikale uya ku nord, ni kuikale anu mashika), bidi biadijinga kuya ni nkotshi ya mashika.
eng_text: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Bule bua dituku mu ete didi mua kukeba malu a kupanga kua tulu ni bukole bua mubidi.
eng_text: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Mu ete, kabidi ikala ni budimu bua tumue tua ku Nord. Nansha katuyi tufila disama nansha dimwe, tudi mua kuku fikisha tshinji.
eng_text: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Economie wa San Fransico udi umbukila ku dikala diende dia kulu mu dikoka dia benyi batangidi ba musoko, economie wende mmushilangane.
eng_text: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Miaba ya mudimu ya dijinga kudi midimu ya bianza, bulombodi bua ditunga, malu a makuta, mushiga, ni kuendakana kua mu musoko.
eng_text: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Udi utamba kumueneka mu misambu, ma films, malu a mikanda, ni malu a bibidilu mbienze bua se musoko ni ma bimfuanyi biende bimanyike buloba bujima.
eng_text: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Fransisco mmuyishe malu a kuendakana kua mu musoko ni nzubu biaka benyi biabunyi, ma restaurant, ninzubu ya mapetangana ya mushinga mukole.
eng_text: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Fransico udi kabidi umwe wa miaba mimpe ya mu musoko bua bikuku bikuabu bia mu Asie: mu kore, Thailand, Inde, ni Japon.
eng_text: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Kuendana ku Walt Disney World bidi bikale pelerinage munene bua meku abunyi a ba American.
eng_text: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: "Luendu" ludi lulomba kuya ku Aeroport wa ditunga dia Orlando, kubanda mu mashini adi aya ku nzubu wa tshaka benyi wa Disney, kupitisha nansha lubingu lujima kakuyi kumbuka mu lupangu lua Disney, ni kupingana ku nzubu.
eng_text: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Kudi bintu biabunyi bishilangane, kadi kudi tshimue tshidi bantu bunvija padibu bakuila bua "Kuya ku Disney World".
eng_text: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Mikanda ya luendu ya bunyi idi isumbisha pa enternete bu pa eBay any Craiglist idi ya park ya matuku a bunyi itumikishibua mu tshitupa.
eng_text: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Malu aa atu enzeka bikole, Disney uka mukandike: ma ticets kaena mua kutumibua.
eng_text: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Bua kulala pambelu mwinshi mua ma jante mu Grand Canyon bikengela djibeji dja kusomba mu djitunga.
eng_text: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Permis idiku bua kukuba mpongu, idiku mu dituku dia kumpala dia ngondo, ngondo inayi kumpala kua ngondo wa ntuadijilu.
eng_text: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Nunku, kupeta djibeji dia kusomba kua mudjitunga kubanga mu ngondo mwitanu bua kumweneka mu le 1er wa ngondo wa kumpala.
eng_text: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Mwaba bu ma quartier a bantu ba bungi, bu mudi tshiladilu tshia Bright Angel pabwipi ni Phantom Ranch, utu uwula ni malombi mapeta mu date wakumpala munzulula bua kukuatshila miaba.
eng_text: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Kudji bunyi bubala bua mabeji a kuendakana nawu, kulomba kunzulula mu djifika, djibanga dja kusakibua kumpala.
eng_text: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Kubuela mu Afrique wa ku Sud ni mashini ki njila mwimpe wa kumona buimpe bonso bua musoko bipitshile kubuelela ku njila wa batangidi ba musoko.
eng_text: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Udi mua kudilongolola bua kuya ni mashini onso kadi 4x4 ki adi malombibue bikole bualu miaba ya bunyi ilomba 4x4 wa kulu bua kuyifika.
eng_text: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Bijinga kuvuluka ne pakudilongolola bua se mudi Afrique du Sud mwikale ni ditalala mbishilangane ni misoko idi mimunyunguluke.
eng_text: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Malu akupeta Visa ni mushinga wende bidi bishilangana bilondeshela ni ditunga ni umupetela mu ditunga didi uluila.
eng_text: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Ditunga dionso didi ni mikandu yadi bua bintu bia mitalu bidi ni tsha kuikala mu mashini.
eng_text: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls mmusoko wa ku est kumwelelu kua Zimbabwe, pabuipi ni mikalu ya Livingstone, Zambie, ni pabuipi ni Botshana.
eng_text: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Musoko udi pabuipi ni ma chutes, ni muikale ni kukokibua kua kumpala, kadi muaba ewu wa buendedi bua buenyi udi upesha bakebi mazaba ni bua ba tourist mushindu wa basombe matuku abunyi.
eng_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Mu tshikondo tsha mvula (ngondo wa Dikumi ni Umwe too ni ku ngondo Mwisatu), bunyi bua mayi ni bubande ni ma Chutes ni ikale a njuwu.
eng_text: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Udi ni tsha kutalala wewe usambuka tshilamba anyi wewe wendela mu tu njila tua bisonsa pabuipi ni ma Chutes.
eng_text: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Luseka lukuabu, mbua bunyi bupite bua mayi ki pikala kumuna kuebe kua Chute ni kuikale kukangibue—ni bunyi bua mayi!
eng_text: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Lukita lua Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 nlukita lumania ku ma nkita a mu Lupongo, dizaba dia kujendula dia Howard Carter dia lukita luvua kaluyi lunyungishibue lua mfumu nsonga mu 1922.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Kufanyikija ni nkita mikuabu ya ba mfumu, ki nunkuewu, lukita lua Tutankhamun ludi lufila luya lua kuluendakanina, luikale lukese menemene ni dilaba mukubu mukumbane.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Muntu yonso udi musue kumuna bivua bifikile tshitalu tshitua manga pa kuteta ku tshipatula mu mushete ni anyingalale bualu anu mutu ni makaya ki bidi bimueneka.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Bubanji bua nsongo buvua mu lukita kabutshenamu, baka babufile ku Musee wa mu Egypte mu Caire.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Bena luendu badi ni meba mabala ni benze bimpe bua kupitisha meba abu miaba mikuabu.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, muikale mu km 12 ku sud-est kua Siem Reap. Tempelu wa musonga ewu uvua muibaka ku ndekelu ku siecle wa 9, mu bukalenga bua Mfumu Yasovarman.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Kumweneka kua kukese kua ntempelu ni kua dijiba dia Tonle Sap bifila dijinga dia kubanda ku mukuna.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Kuendakana kua pa muaba ewu kudi mua kuenzeka ni buatu pa dijiba.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Dipita dia pa Angkor didi dilombibue bua kubuela mu ntempelu nunku kuyi kupa moyo passeport webe paudi uya ku Tonle Sap.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jerusalem ki tshimamuende a bukalenga tsha musoko munene wa Isalele, nansha mudi matunga makuabu ni Nations Unis kabayi bitaba ni ntshimamuende a bukalenga tsha Isalele.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Musoko wa kale wa mu mikuna ya Judee udi ni lusumuinu luimpe lua kale bikole.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Musoko udi munsantu bua bitendelelu bisatu bia nzambi umwe - Judaisme, Christianisme ni Islam, ni muikale muaba musantu, wa bitendelelu, ni wa mazaba.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Bua mushinga wa bitendelelu bia mu musoko, ni bua bitupa bia miaba ya bunyi ya Musoko wa Kale, Jerusalem mmuaba udi ba touriste baya bikole bua mu Isalele.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jerusalem udi miaba ya bunyi ya nsumuinu, mifuba ya kale ni ya mazaba, muikale ni bisalu, miaba ya kunuina ni ya kudila miuwule ni bantu.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Equateur udi ulomba ba mu Cuba bua kupeta mukanda wa dibikidibua kumpala kua kubuela mu Equateur kupitshila tshipalu anyi miaba ya kupitshila ya mu mikalu.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Mukanda ewu udi ni tsha kutuibua tshitampi tsha Kavula Mbedi wa mianda ya benyi wa mu Equateur, ni kunemeka bidi bilombibue.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Mikandu eyi idi miteka bua kupitisha bantu ba nseke yonso mu bulongame budi bukengela.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Ba mu Cuba badi ni tuarte tua manyi a matamba tua mu US badi ni tsha kuya ku Consulat wa mu Equateur bua kupeta ditaba dia pabuadi.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Passeport weba udi ni tsha kuikala mwimpe ngondo isambombo kunyima kua matuku a ngendu. Mukanda wa luendu wa kuya/ni kupingana udi wa dijinga bua kumanya bunyi bua matuku awenza.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Visites idi ya mushinga muimpe nuenu bikale babunyi, wewe nkaya anyi ni mulunda webe umwe, kebayi bantu bakuabu bua nuikale banayi anyi basambobo bua kupeta mushinga muimpe pa muntu.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Kadi, kabiena bia mushinga menemene to, bualu tourist yabunyi itu pabuipi bua kuwuja mashini.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Bikadi bimueneka mpidiewu ni mmushindu wa kuleja ku bantu ni mbijinga kufuta biabunyi.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Ku luseke lua kumutu kua mayi kua Macchu Picchu kudi mukuna mutumbuke, meba abunyi ufanangana ni bindimbi bia bintu bishadile binyanguke.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Wenza bowa lua muinshi, ni diwubanda didi dikole, kadi bantu badi ni bukole bua mubidi badi mua kuwubanda mu minutes 45.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Mabwe mmateka pa miaba ya bunyi ya kuendela, ni pa miaba ya mikuna nshinga ya milonda idi yambuluisha bua kubanda.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Ebi bileja ne, dilongololayi bua kupanga mieyelu, ni ikalayi ni budimu mu miaba ya mikuna, nangananga padimu mutalale, idi ilua ya njuwu.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Kudi ka muaba ka muinshi mua buloba mu nudi ni tsha kupitshila, kadi muinshi menemene ni kakese.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Bidi bimpe kuendakana mu tshitupa etshi ni bukua nnyama bua mu Galapagos mu buatu, muvua Charle Drawin mwenze mu 1835.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Matu matue ku 60 atu endakana pa mayi a Galapagos - angata bantu batue ku 8 too ni ku 100.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Bantu babunyi bakuatshila miaba kumpala (muntu matu atu uwula pa tshibidilu mu tshikondo tsha kulu).
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Ikala mujadike ni kunudi nu kuatshila miaba nkua muntu mupiluke wa mu Galapagos muikale ni dimanya dia matu abunyi.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Etshi ni tshibaleje ni dijinga diebe/anyi buenzeji budi bupetangana ni buatu bua buimpe menemene buabu.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Kumpala kua ba Espagnol kufika mu 16th siecle, Chili wa ku nord uvua mu bukokeshi bua ba Inca pavua bena tshisuku ba mu Araucanie (Mapuche) basomba mu nkatshi mua Chili wa ku sud.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Ba Mapuche bavu kabidi bamue ba ba Americain badisombele ba mu tshisuku, bavua kabayi bapite mu kabujima mu bukokeshi bua muakulu wa ba Espagnol too ni ku dipanda dia Chili.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Nansha pavua Chili mu lombe dipanda mu 1810 (munkatshi mua mvita ya Napoleon ivua mishiye Espagne kayi ni bulombodi bua ditunga mu bidimu bibidi), dipangidika dia kutshimuna ba Espagnol divua diye too ni mu 1818.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Republique Dominicaine (mu Espagnole: Republica Dominicana) nditunga dia ba Caribbean divu diangate tshitupa tshia Est tshia luseka lua munkatshi mua mâyi lua Hispaniola, tshidi diabanyangana ni Haiti.
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Luseka lua lusenga lutoke lua kuluseka lua mâyi ni bimfuanyi bua mikuna, ditunga didi ni misoko yakale ya ba Europeens mu Amerique, pindiewu mu tshitupa tshia Santo Domingo.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Ba Tainos ni ba Caraibes ki bakunpala muku somba mu Island. Ba Caraibes bavu bakula muakulu wa Arawakan bavu bafike bidimu bitue ku 10.000 kumpala kuetu.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Mu tshitupa tshia tshidjimu kulondeshela kufika kua batoke bajendudji ba mu Europe, bena djitunga dja Tainos bavu bakokeshibua kudji bukokeshi bua ba Espagnole.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Kupitshila Fray Bartolome de las casas (Tratado de las Indias) munkatshi mua 1492 ni 1498, bakokeshi ba mu Espagne bakashipa ba Tainos batue ku 100.000.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardin de la Union. Muaba ewu uvua muibaka bu atrium bua couvent wa 17th siecle, ku bionso Templo de San Diego ki nzubu umwe udi mushale.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Udi muikale lelu bu muaba wa midimu, ni diba dionso kudi anu bintu biabunyi bia kuenza, munya ni butuku.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Kudi bunyi bukumbane bua ma restaurant ku luseke lua budimi, ni mu ma dilolo kudi ma concert a tshanana adi enzeka mu nkatshi mua muaba wa kulu.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Balcon ibidi mishilangane anu ku 69 centimetre mmuaba wa lusumuinu lua kale lua dinanga.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Bua makuta makese bana kampanda ni ba kuelele lusumuinu.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Buloba bua pa mayi bua Bowen nluendu lua bantu babunyi anyi luendu lua kundekelu kua lubingu muikale ma kayak, ma randonee, bisalu, ma restaurant, ni bikuabu.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Communaute wa kale ewu udi mu Howe Sound ku muelelu kua Vancouver, ni dimubuela didi dipupale kupitshila matu taxi adi umbuka mu Granville Island to ni munkatshi mua tshimenga tsha Vancouver.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Badi banange mazaba a pmbelu, randonee wa mu couloir Sea to Sky udi wa dijinga.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Muedi wa kashiba (diba 1.5 kuendesha mashinyi kubangishila mu Vancouver) tshidi nushinga mukole bualu bua manaya a olympique a mu muvu wa mashika wa mu 2010.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Mu muvu wa mashika, upeta disanka dia manaya ya Skii mu Amerike wa ku Nord, kadi mu muvu wa été kuteta bujalame bua kubanda ku mikuna.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Bikengela kulama mushindu wa ku buela nau kumpala kua dîba. Bikengela kulua ne mushindu wa ku lala nau ku Sirena.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena udi muaba umue nkaya udi ne basalayi badi mua ku kupesha nzubu wa kulala ne biakuja bia kadilu kumbusha tshitudilu.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Udi mua kupeta mushindu wa ku buela nau mu tshipalu kudi pa Biro bia Basalayi mu Puerto Jiménez, kadi kabena bitaba ma tuarte tua makuta.
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Diambuluisha dia nu tshipalu (MINAE) kadiena dipesha mushindu wa ku buela nau kumpala kua diba dipita ngondo umua, bua bavua balua kumpala.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol udi upesha mudimu wa dielakana ulombela mfranga US$30, anyi $10 bua kupita kumua; katoba ne mu katoba kupitshila dibeji Corcovado wabu.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Bidiila bia Cook bidi ditunga mu bulongolodi budikadidi ne Nouvelle-Zélande, mu Polynésie, mu nkatshi mua Mbuu wa Pasifike wa ku Sud.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Etshi bidiila tshidibu ne 15 bidiila mmuolole pa 2.2 milio km2 wa mbuu.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Ni diba dimue ne tshimenga tshia Hawaii, bidiila ebi ba bielela meji ne "Hawaii wa muinshi".
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Nansha mukese, idi ivuluija benyi bakulakaje ba Hawaii panyipa pa tshimenga, kakuvua bilala benyi bia bena ngendu and malongoloji makuabu.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Bidiila bia Cook kabiena ne bisamba kadi bidi ne 15 bidiila bishilangana. Bia binene bidi Rarotonga ne Aitutaki.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Lelu mu matunga mabanji, kupesha bulalu buimpe ne biakudia ivua ma bandishe bua kwenza tshilengejilu.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Ndekelu ya ku mutu, B&B bulele ukumbaja nangananga bitnu bibidi: bulalu ne biakudia.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Bua bualu ebu, kutambe buimpe bisumbu bia nanku muntu udi ne mua kupeta bulalu bua buimpa kupita, pamuapu bulalu buenza ne bianza anyi bulalu buakale.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Biakuja bidi ne kuya ne mvula ya disanka mu tshimenga etshi anyi biakuja bia muenyi.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Muaba eu udi mua kuikala nzubu udi ne udi ne bintu bia kale bia mu miyiki, miaba ya kulongolola makasa ne dijiba dia kowela.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Kubuela mu mashinyi a we nkayeba ne kuenda mu njila udi ne dimueneka dinene mu mushindu mupepele.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Bishilangane ne mashinyi manena, udi mumanye mua kuendesha mashinyi yeba ne kumanya mikalu yenda.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Kulongolola ntenta mu muaba ya muntu nkayende anyi mu tshimenga tshia bunena bua mushindu budi bukoka ntema ya bantu ba bungi.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Mu tshikuma, kutumikisha mashinyi idi mushindu munene wa kuendakana mu njila ya ku "tshitudilu".
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Tshitudilu tshia mashinyi tshia mua kuikala koku anu wewa ne minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon ne nkuasa ya kuladila.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Bilala benyi bikuabu bitu ni bubanji bua tshikondo tsha or tsha njila ya kaulu ka lupepela ni matu, kumpala kua Mvita Mibidi ya buloba bujima, mu siecle wa 19 anyi ku ntuadijilu ku siecle wa 20.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Bilala benyi ebi bivua biakidila babanji ni bantu bamanike ba mu tshikondo atshi ni bavua benza ma restoran a bukalanga ni malu a butuku.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Dienza dia malu bu pa kale, kupangila tudiendelandela tua matuku aa ni bintu bikuabu bia mpindiewu bidi kabidi mu nsombelu wabu.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Nansha kabiyi bia mbula matadi, bitu biakidila meba makuabu balombodi ba Matunga ni bantu ba tshitembu bakuabu.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Muena luendu udi ni makuta abunyi udi mua kuniunguluka buloba bujima, ni mu kuimana kuende upitisha matuku mu bilala benyi ebi.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Kasumbu ka malu a kuakidila bantu ki katu kalunga bena ngendu bantu ba mu bimenga bidibu baya kuendela buenyi.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Bua kubuela mu kasumbu ka nunku, udi ni tsha ku funda pa dibeji dimue pa enternete, nansha mutu tusumbu tukuabu tukontolola kabidi.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Badi bafunda mena a bakididi ba bantu pa dibeji anyi/pa enternete, misangu mikuabu mikale ni bimanyishilu ni miaku ya bena ngedu bakuabu.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing uvua mufuka mu ngondo wa kumpala wa 2004 kunyima kua muteki wa ma program a informatique Casey Fenton kupeta ndeke wa mushinga mutekete wa Island, kadi kavua ni muaba wa kutudila.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Uvua mutume mukanda ku balongi ba tulasa tua kulu tua mu ditunga ni yeye kupeta mandamuna mapite a kupeta miaba ya kulala ya tshanana.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Biaka benyi bitu biakuila nangananga ba nsonga - bantu ba bidimu makumi abidi - kadi mutu ni bantu bakole.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Meku ni bana batekete kabatuku pa tshibidilu, kadi biaka benyi bikuabu bitu bibateka mu nzubu ya nkayabu.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Tshimenga tsha Pekin, mu Chine, ni tshakidile ma Jeux olympique a mu hiver mu 2022, ni bienze ni tshikale tshimenga tsha kumpala tshidi tshakidile mazaba Olympique a mu ete ni mu hiver.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Pekin ni enzeshe manaya a diunzulula ni a dikanga ni mateta a pa dibue ditalale di mu nzubu wa mazaba.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Mateta makuabu a ski ni enzekele mu tshipalu tsha ski tsha Taizicheng mu Zhangjiaku, pa bule bua km 220 (140 miles) ni pekin.
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Ntempelu ya bunyi itu ni tshibilu tsha ku tshidimu tshitu tshibanga nikundekelu kua ngodo wa dikumi ni umwe ni tshijika munkatshi mua ngondo muitanu, ni tshikudimuka kulondangana ni calendrier wa ku tshidimu wa ntempelu yonso.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Bibilu abunyi a ma ntempelo atu enzeka diba dia anniversaire wa ntempelo, anniversaire wa ba nzambi batu balombola ntempelu anyi diba dia tshibilu tshonso tshinene tsha ntempelu.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Bibilu a ntempelu wa Kerala atu mimpe ku amuna, bua milongo ya tupumbu tulaba mukubu, kasumbu ka bimbi ba ku ntempelu ni bibilu bikuabu.
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Dileja dia bintu dia buloba bujima (badibikila nunku pa tshibidilu, anyi Expo) ndifesto dinene dia bukua bisamba dia kuleja bintu bilengeja ni bia mikanda.
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Matunga atu munda atu aleja bintu bilengeja ni bia malongesha mu ma pavillon a mu musoko bua kupesha malu a buloba bujima anyi mushindu wabu wa kuenza malu ni lusumuinu lua ditunga diabu bujitu.
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Dileja dia mushindu wa kudima dia bukuabisamba mbibilu bia pabuabi bidi bileja bilongo, miaba ya tu madimi ni bionso bidi bitangile mitshi.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Nansha mudibi ni tsha kuenzeka bidimu bionso (bidi ni tsha kuenzekela mu matunga mashilangane), bitu kabiyi bienzeka.
eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Bibilu ebi bitu biangata ngondo kubangila pa isatu ni ku isambombo ni bienzekela pa bipalu bia hectares 50.
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Kudi bunene bushilangane bua ma film ivubu batangila kukadi bidimu biabunyi. Ma film standard a mm 35 (negatif wa mm 36 pa 24) ki ya pa tshibidilu.
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Batu mua kumubangulula bipupale pa tshibidilu wewe mumu pangile, ni bindidimbi bikale pabuipi ni kufanangana ni bindidimbi bia nimerik bia lelu.
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Biamua bikuabu bia bindidimbi bia ma film bia bunene bukumbanyine bitu bitumika ni bunene bua cm 6 pa 6, ni ndudi negatif wa mm 56 pa 56.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Bidi bienza bunene misangu inayi bipitshile pa negatif wa mm 35 (mm2 3136 pa 864).
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Bukuanyama bua muitu ntshimfanyi tshikole bua mukuatshi wa bindidimbi, ni bilomba diakalenga, lutulu, dimanya ni biakuluata bia nsongo.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Dikuata dia bindidimbi muitu bitu bu bipupale, kadi bu bua bukuatshi bua bindidimbi bionso, tshindidimbi tshimue mmiaku tshinunu.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Dikuata dia bindidimbi ku niama ya muitu ditu dilomba teleobjectif wa mule, nansha mutu bintu bikuabu bu dibuka dia nyunyi anyi ka tshifukilu kakakese bitu bilomba ma objectif makuabu.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Nyama yabunyi ya pambelu pa ditunga itu mikole bua kuyipeta, ni ma park atu ni mikandu bua dikuata dia bindidimbi bia kupana.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Nyama ya muitu idi mua kuikala ni lutulu anyi ya lonji. Muaba udi mua kuikala mutalale, wa luya anyi mubi.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Kudi miakulu 5000 mishilangane pa buloba bujima, ni makumi abidi mikale ni bayakudi millions 50 any bapite.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Miaku mifunda itu yumvuika bipitshile miakula. Bu ma discours atu makole bua ku akula mu mushindu wa bantu bumvue.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Matunga abunyi atu mamanye Anglais bimpe, ni mu bunyi bukumbane, tudi mua kufika ku dimanya dia nshikidilu - nangananga ku ba nsonga.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Elayi menji, nuenu basue, Manucunien, Bostonien, Jamaicain ni Sydneysider basombe ku mensa bua kudia mu restoran wa mu Toronto.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Bazaba mu bulunda bua nsumuinu ya matunga abu, miakula mu tsha kuabu ni mu mushindu wa kuakula kuabu.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Kusumba biakudia mu ma supermarche pa tshibidilu mmushindu wa kudia ku mushinga wa panshi. Kakuyi mushindu wa kulamba, masungula adi imanyina pa biakudia bilamba.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Ku misangu yonso, ma supermarche adi enza muaba wa biakudia bilamba. Bakuabu badi too ni ma micro-ondes anyi mishindu mikuabu ya kubabaja biakudia.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Mu matunga makuabu anyi magazin a nunku, mutu nansha restoran, misangu ya bunyi kayiyi bu mikuabu ni bela mushinga muimpe.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Vudija mabeji ebe a ba mpulushi ni bintu bia mukubi webe ni wikale nabiu.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Adi ni tsha kuikala ne adresse wa enternete wa mukubi ni nimero ya telefone ya bukuabisamba bua mibelu/kuitaba ni kulomba mafutu.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Ikala ni dibeji dikuabu mu mabuki ebe anyi pa enternete (e-mail webe ni tsha kulamika, anyi tshilama mu "cloud").
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Wewe uya mu luendu ni ordinatere wa ku bianza anyi telephone munene, lama dibeji dimue mu memuar anyi pa disk (mua kubuela kakuyi enternete).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Pesha kabidi mabeji a politik/ma contakte ku baudi wenza nabu luenduni ku baledi anyi balunda bavua bashale mu ditunga badi mua kukuambuluisha.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Nyama ya elans (mimanya kabidi mu dina dia wapitis) ka itu ni bukitu bua kuluisha, kadi idi mua kuluisha bua kudikuba bobo ba iluishe.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Padi bantu kabayi bamanye ni itu ya lonji pa tshibidilu, badi mua kusemena pabuipi ni kudi teka mu njuwu.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Kunua mala a ndengu nyi ditshintshika. Mala adi akuata muntu yonsu mu mushindu mushilangana, ne kumanya mikalu yeba bimpa bikola.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Evenement ya sante ya milepa idi yenzeka kupitshila ku dipitshisha dia dinua dia maluvu idi bua kunianga mutshima ne nansha bu mpofu ne lufu. Difika dia njuwu didi divula ku dinua dia maluvu a ndengu adi kahayi menza mu bulongolodi buimpa nansha.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Anyima mubi udi bua kuikala ne njiwu mibi mishilashilangana kukumbaja ne methanol, udi mua kufikisha ku bu mpofu eshi lufu nansha mu ditshintshika.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Maneta a mesu adi muakuikala mushinga mukesa mu matunga makuabu, nangananga mu matunga a benefice mikesa ne mushinga wa dienzelangana mudimu mukesa.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Itabuja kuenza mateta a disu kuenu, nangananga owu munda mua asurance, ne kulua ne bipeta bua kujikijila muaba mukuabu.
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Dina dia tshienzelu dia mushiunga wa kulu udi koku mu miaba eyi did ne malu abidi; mikuabu idi buakuikala mitentula, ne bilelela bidi bifuma pambelu bidi buakuikala mushinga mukola ke kumbelu.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: cafe kadi kamua ka ku bintu bitubu bahana bikola mu bulaba bujima, ne udi bua kupeta mishindu ya bungi mu tshijengu dia kumbelu kueba.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Kadi nanku, kudi mishindu ya bungi ya dinua cafe mu bulaba bujima idi experience mimpa.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Canyoning (eshi: canyoneering) mbua kuya kuinshi kua canyon, kadi bua kuikala kuma eshi kula tenta na mayi.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Canyoning udi usangisha bintu bia ku diowela, dibanda ne ditumpika‑‑kadi bidi bilomba didibidija kampanda dikesa eshi mubidi wa makanda bua kubangisha (mu dishilangana ne dibanda dia mabua, diela dia mutiki anyi ski wa alpin, bu tshilejelu).
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Luendu lua makasa ludi activite wa pambelu udi ne tshiena bualu tshia kuenda mu miaba naturel, nangananga mu sentier randonnee.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Dituku dia luendu didi ne tanta muihi ku meta amua to ne ku tanata muleha udibu mua kujikija mu dituku dimuehela.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Bua dituku dia luendu mu sentier wa mu hehela didilongolola dikesa ndilombibua, ne muntu yonsu udi moyennement mu forme udi bua kusanka nayi.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Meku adi ne bana bateketa adi bua kukeba didilongolola diabungi, kadi dituku dia pambelu didi dihehela bua kuenzeka nansha ne bana batoka ne bana ba mu maternelle.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Internationallement, kudi toure ya mbilu pabuipi ne 200. Yabungi itu yenzeka ngaya.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Toure ya mbilu ya bulaba idi ilonda, ndaku toure ya mbilu ya reseau ya dizaines ya banyemi ba sightrunning mu matumba anayi a bulaba.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Nyi mija mu Dinyema dia Barcelona mu Toure ya mbilu ya mu Barcelona ne Dinyema dia Copenhague mu Mbilu ya Copenhague, bivu bipeta lukasa kudi Toure ya Mbilu ya Prague mishindamena mu Prague ne miaba mikuabu.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Kudi bintu bia bungi bi udi ne tshiabua kuangata ne mushinga kumpala ne padi wenza luendu muaba kampanda.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Padi wenza luendu, teka mu menji se bintu kibiakala mudibi "kumbelu" to. Manieres, mikenji, biadidia, diendakana, dimuangala, normes, muakulu ne mishindu mikuabu ya muaba udi usomba ne ishilangana.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Etshi tshidi tshintu tshi udi ne bua kulama mu menji misangu yonsu, bua kuehuka difika dia munda eshi nansha ditonda dia mushindu wa kuenza malu wa bena muabau.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Agence ya luemdu ikavu koku katshia 19em siecle. Agent wa luendu utu pa tshibidilu lungenyi luimpa bua luendu ludi luya kumpala kua experience mushala wa muenji wa luendu lua kubandila bufuki, kabukulu, muakulu eshi matunga a revenu mikesa.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Nansha nanku agences yonsu idi ijinga bua kuangata dikuatshila, agent yabungi idi specialise mu ngendu kampanda ya mushindu ewu, ku controle intervale anyi destination.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Bidi buakala bimpa bua kuenza ne agent utu ukuatshila misangu mivula ngendu ya diatshimua ne yeba.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Ela mesu ku ngendu kayi idi agent ufila, nyi mu site eshi mu victrine.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Wewa ukeba kumona bulaba pa udi mu buatu, bua necessite, mode wa vie eshi defi, kudi mishindu ya kubienza.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Bangabanga, bidi bimata mu categories ibidi: nyi dienza mudimu padi wenza luendu eshi kuela mikalu pa ditula dieba. Article ewu udi mushindamena pa ndekelu.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Bua badi bajinga ku sacrifier confort, diba ne lumuanu bua ku pusa ditula panshi pabuipi ne tshijengu, tangila controle mukesa wa luendu.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Mubelu udi uleja se bena ngedu kabena biba, ba divuinga, babuela mu tshisalu tshia malu makandikibua, balomba, eshi mikuabu misangu ku utilise bantu bakuabu bua interet yabu nkayabu.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Muaba wa ku controler bamuangadi udi nangananga muaba wa kumpala udi wimana padi utuluka mu ndeka, mu mazuwa, eshi mashinyi makuabu.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Mu disambuka mikalu mikuabu ba controle wa mu tuwulu udi wenzeka adi kawulu mu lubilu ne udi ne tshia bua kuikala nyi Identite muimpa padi usambuka nyi kamua ka ku tuwulu atu.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Mu tuwulu tua butuku, passeports idi bua kuangatshibua kudi muendeshi bua se ki ba kunyangidi tulu to.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Difunda didi dikumbaja dia bidibikengedibua bua processus wa visa. Mu matunga makuabu, udi ne tshia bua kufunda dikalangana dieba ne muaba udi usomba kudi officier ya muabau.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Bidi bua kulomba kuja mukanda ne officier ya tshitupa atshi etshi diela mesu ku bureau bia bamuangadi.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Mu matunga abungi nyi mukenji wa nunku, bilala benyi bia muabau ne bijikija bualu bua difunda (tuishibue se udi mukonka).
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Mu malu makuabu, anu batu basomba pambelu pa nzubu ya ben ngendu kibadi ne tshia bua ku difundisha. Pananku, tshidi tshienza mukenji kawuyi wumvuika bimpa to, nanku manya kumpala.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Architecture udi bua kuzola ne kuibaka bibambalu. Architecture wa muaba ngayenda utu ubikila bena luendu.
eng_text: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Bibambalu bia bungi bitu bimpa kumona ne dimuenena dia ku musongu wa tshibambalu tshia tshileha eshi kumuenena pa fenetre kudi bua kuikala kuimpa bua kumona.
eng_text: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Architecture mulehesha cosiderablement nyi bialu bikuabu ku kumbaja ne dilongolola dia urbain, engenieur civil, muenji wa buimpa kumona, muzodi wa munzubu ne dizola di bindidimbi.
eng_text: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Ba peshibua tshihidi kayi tshidi pueblos yabungi mikala, kua ku kumbana bua kupeta bungi bukumbana bua vie nocturne kakuyi dienza luendu ku Albuquerque eshi Santa Fe.
eng_text: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Pananku, casino yonsu idi mitela kumutu idi ifila bia kunua, ne mikuabu ya mu yoyi itu ilua ne muyuki wa mena a bintu (bangabanga ne wa mupeha awu udi mujinga Albuquerque ne Santa Fe musangu umua).
eng_text: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Manya se: bars ya mu cite ya mikesa aha kayitu muaba muimpa bua benyi kupitshisha diba to.
eng_text: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Bua tshintu tshimua, nord wa me Mexique Mupiamupia udi ne malu mahita nyi diendesha dia mukuatshika, ne sangilu wa bendeji ba ndengu udi wabungi pabuipi ne bars ya cite mukesa.
eng_text: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Mazodi adi kabayi bananga eshi griffonner mumanyika bu graffiti.
eng_text: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Padibi kuleha kumbukila ku phenomene modrne, bantu ba bungi batu ba bisangisha ne bansonga ba vandaliser bantu ne tshibambalu tshia muntu wenzela mukubu wa di pompe.
eng_text: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Pananku, matukuaha kudi ba graffeur bajadikibua, evenement ya graffiti ne bimanu "bitabuijibua". Mikubu ya graffiti mu diakula edi itu isanga midimu ya buimpa kumona pamutu pa balise illisibles.
eng_text: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Dikuha dia boomerang didi competence munangibua udi bendakanyi babungi bakeba kupeta.
eng_text: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Wewa ukeba bua kumanya dikuha dia boomerang idi ipingana ku bianza kueba, jadikibua se udi ne boomerang mimpa bua dipingana.
eng_text: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Boomerangs yabungi idi koku mu Australie idi ya kayiyi ipingana to. Bidi bimpa bua babangi kibatetshi kukuwa mu lupepa to.
eng_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Biakudia bia Hangi bidi bilambibua mu disoso dia mudilu mu bulaba.
eng_text: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Disosu didi buakala difila mudilu umbukila ku nkunyi, eshi mu miaba mikuabu ya luya lua geothermique idi yenza mudilu naturel pa tshitupa tshia bulaba.
eng_text: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Hangi itu mienzela pa tshibidilu bua kulamba roti ya kabukulu mu mushindu wa biakudia bia dilolo.
eng_text: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Miaba yabungi mu Rotorua idi ifila hangi geothermique, padi hangi mikuabu idi buakala echantillonne mu ekelezia wa kilisto, Wellington ne miaba mikuabu.
eng_text: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail udi ne miaba ibidi munda mua tuwulu tua banlieue ne ku Cape Town: MetroPlus (ubikidibua kabidi se First Class) ne Metro (abikidibua se Third Class).
eng_text: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus udi muimpa bikola ne katu ne bantu babungi to kadi udi mushinga mukola, bimpa mudiyi mushala mushinga mukesa ke billet bia metro normal mu Europe.
eng_text: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Kawulu konso kadi ne bionsu MetroPlus ne Metro coaches; MetroPlus coaches idi pa dibidilu kundekelu kua kawulu pabuipi ne Cape Town.
eng_text: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Kuambuila bakuabu ‑ Kulekedi tshibiuta tshieba tanta neba to, nangananga padi usambuka mikalu ya ditunga.
eng_text: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Udi bua kudisangana mu buenzeji bua drogue kakuyi dimanya dieba, bidi mua ku kufikisha mu bilumbu.
eng_text: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Bidi bikumbaja ne dindila mu mulongu, bua se badi bua kuenzela kabua katu kakepa drogue kakuyi dimanyisha.
eng_text: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Matunga makuabu adi ne dinyioka excessivement draconienne nansha bua musangu wa kumpala wa dituwakana; bidi bisangisha nyi diela mu lukana bua bidimu 10 eshi lufu.
eng_text: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Bibuta bidi kabayi batangila bidi bibadila bua kuiba ne bidi bua ku tirer attention wa balombodi badi batangila menace a bombe.
eng_text: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Kumbelu, kupitshila ku exposition constant ku germes ya muabau, chance idi yabungi se ukadi immunise kudibu.
eng_text: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Kadi mu tshituha tshikuabu tshia buloba, kudi faune bacteriologique mihiamihia kudi, udi kuleha bikola bua kututakena ne bilumbu.
eng_text: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Kabidi, mu climat ya luya bacteries idi yonsu idi ikola lukasa bikola ne yi vivre bikola pambelu pa mubidi.
eng_text: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Nanku fleau wa Delhi Belly, dinyiokibua dia Pharaoh, vengeance wa Montezuma, ne balunda babu babungi.
eng_text: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Nyi bualu bua mupuyakenu mu climat wa mashika, bualu bua mala mu climat ya luya bidi bimpa diatshimua ne mu malu abungi bidi bimueneka bitonda kadi kaniena nangananga njiwu to.
eng_text: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Wewa muenza luendu mu ditunga ditantshishibua bua musangu wa kumpala – eshi mu tshituha tshipiamupia tshia bulaba – ku keki potentiel wa choc wa kabukulu nansha.
eng_text: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Bikumbi bia bungi, muenda ngendu wa bukokeshe bamukokesha kudi dilongoloshia dia dipiadipia dia luendu kua pa buloba, kudi ba bungi badi bidilangana ne bibidilu bikese bikese.
eng_text: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Nangananga mu matuku a kumpala, ela menji bua ku kangula nzubu ya bilala benyi, ne biakudia, ne mudimu wa dinanga bu mudi mu matunga menyi.
eng_text: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Kuladi pa matelat anyi kulala pa biata pa buloba mu miaba udi wewe kuena mu manye ne nyama idi momu.
eng_text: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Nuenu nuya kulala mu tshipela, angata bulalalu anyi hamac bua kuikala kule ni nyoka, tuminyiminyi ni bikuabu.
eng_text: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Uwujayi ni kafe mu nzubu wenu mudinda ni tshayi tshela camomille tsha kusanguluja mubidi dilolo.
eng_text: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Panudi mu dikisha, nudi ni diba dia kuzaba ni minutes mikese ya pamutu bua kulongolola tshintu tsha pabuatshi.
eng_text: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Wewe ukeba kuteta, longolola jus wa bimuma anyi bia kunua bia bimuma bitalale.
eng_text: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Ni upete pakuabu tsha kunua tshipupale tshi udi mua kuenza bua tshakudia tsha mudinda pa wa bangulula tshilele tshebe tsha matuku onso.
eng_text: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Wewe usombela mu tshimenga mudi maluvu mashilangane, yaku mu miaba ya kunuina maluvu anyi mu ma pubs a mu quartier mu utu kuyi uya.
eng_text: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Badi kabayi bamanye miakulu ya londapi, miaku kutampakana ni tshambu mmiaku mishilangane.
eng_text: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Disama dia ditampakana ditu diluila ku tshishi tsha disama, bu virus, bacterie, champignon anyi bishi bikuabu.
eng_text: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Disama dia tshambu ditu diya kudi muntu mukuabu udi pabuipi ni muntu udi mukuatshike ni disama.
eng_text: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Matunga abunyi atu alomba ku benyi badi baya mu ditunga diabu, anyi ba mu ditunga badi bamu patuka, bapete bisalu bia masama mashilangane.
eng_text: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Mikenji eyi itu pa tshibidilu ilonda matunga adi muena luendu muendele, anyi mudi yi usua kuya.
eng_text: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Bukole bumue bua Charlotte, mu Caroline wa ku Nord, mbualu utu ni bintu bia bunyi bia bimpe bua meku.
eng_text: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Ba mu bimenga bikuabu batu batela dipetangana dia meku bu tshintu tsha kumpala tsha ku sombela mu, ni benyi batu ba muna tshimenga tshikale tshipupale bua ku tshendela ni bana ku luseke.
eng_text: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Mu bidimu 20 bishale, bunyi bua bintu bilongolola bua bana mu Uptown Charlotte buvua bubande mu mushindu wa dikema.
eng_text: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Meku ka atu abanda pa tshibidilu mu ma taxi mu Charlotte, nansha mutu yu ya dijinga meba makuabu.
eng_text: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Kudi bia kukumbaja bua bantu babidi, nimuni option ewu udi mua kuikala mushinga mupite.
eng_text: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antarctica muaba udi ni mashika makola bua buloba bujima, ni tshigengu tshia pole wa kubutshika.
eng_text: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Diela dia mesu dia bendakanyi didi mushinga mukola, dilomba makanda a mubidi, ditu dienzekibua anu mu tshikondo tshia munya Ngondo wa Dikumi ne Umue ne Ngondo Muibidi, ne malepa makashikila ku Penisula, Islands ne mâyi a Ross.
eng_text: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Bantu batua ku tshinunu badi basomba muaba eu mu cikondo cia munya mikuabu miaba makumi anayi ne muanda mukulu itubu basomba nangananga bigengu biebia; bantu bakesa ki batu basomba mu cikondo cia mashika.
eng_text: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Plateau wa munda mua Antartique udi mushala nkayenda mubuikila kudi 2-3 kilometa wa mâyi a mabua.
eng_text: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Bena dimanya dia kuendela mu lupepela ba ku misangu mbaya munda, bua kubanda mikuna eshi bua kufika ku Pole, udi ne bangilu munena.
eng_text: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: South Pole Traverse (anyi Highway) ntshitupa tsha km 1600 tshumbukila ku station McMurdo, pa mbuwa wa Ross, ku pole.
eng_text: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Nneje mukuatakane ni ma crevasse muule ni mimanyika ni dibendele. Idi mua kupitshibua kudi tutumba tua paluatu, tukoka ma nkalu mikale ni kasoloni ni bia kudia.
eng_text: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Katutu ni lubilu lukole, ni tshipapu tshinyunguluka kudi Mikuna ya pabuipi ni Antarctique bua kufika mu mpata.
eng_text: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Tshitu tshienzesja njuwu meba onso mu hiver mbuselu mu njila, miaba ya bantu (trotoirs) ni nangananga pa miaba ya ku diatshila.
eng_text: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Bijinga wikale ni bisabata bia bidiatshilu bimpe. Bisabata bia mu ete bitu pa tshibidilu bia buselu pa dibue dia mashika ni pa neje, nansha bikumba bikuabu bia mu hiver kabitu bifanyine.
eng_text: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Motif udi ni tsha kuikala ni ndondo, mm 5 (pouce 1/5) anyi mipite, ni bintu bipupale bikole bua diba dia mashika.
eng_text: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Bikumba bikuabu bitu ni misonso ni kudi bintu bidi ni misonso bua meba a buselu, bienza ku bisabata biabunyi ni bikumba, bua bidiatshilu anyi bidiatshilu ni mwinshi mua bisabata.
eng_text: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Bidiatshilu bidi ni tsha kuikala bia panshi ni bile mu bule. Lusenga, mabue anyi luepu (chlorure wa sodium) batu ba biela mu njila anyi njila minene bua kubandisha bukole.
eng_text: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Mabue a mashika ka atu mabi; mikuna mikole idi mua kukuata neje mukese tshanana bitekete, ni bunene bukuabu bua pamutu bu mabue a mashika.
eng_text: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Lutatu, mbualu neje utu ukuata ni muikale dijinga ni tshintu tshidi mua kuenza bua akuluke, tshitupa tsha neje tshidi tshikuluka tshidi mua kukulula mikuabu.
eng_text: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Pakuabu, neje udi mua kukuluka munia yeye mu kume pu, anyi dikuluka dikuabu dia neje, anyi bintu bikuabu bia pa buloba, meba abunyi muntu.
eng_text: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Vunda mmulongo wa lupepele lua dinyunguluka dikese, udi ukoka mpepele ya kumuelelu munda ni mulu.
eng_text: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Utu ukeba bipepele bikole (pa tshibidilu miles/heure 100 ku 200) ni bidi mua kubukisha bintu bia bujitu, ni bisemena nabiu padi vunda usemena.
eng_text: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Itu ibanga bu milongeji ya yumbukila mu matutu mafike ni bilu "mvunda" padibiu bilenga buloba.
eng_text: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Batu bafila ma VPN (reseau prive virtuel) a muntu bitu mushindu muimpe wa kusambuka manyoka a ditunga ni ma filtrage a mushinga.
eng_text: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Itu mipite ma proxies web bua bia bunyi: Itu ifila bionso bidi bipita pa enternete, ka biyi http nkayende to.
eng_text: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Bitu bipitisha ngumu ya pa mukaba wa kuinshi mile ni diambuluisha dimpe. Itu mikanga, nimuni bikole bua ku iba.
eng_text: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Kumpanyi ya ma media itu iteka pa tshibidilu pa objectif wa code, bamba ne mbua "kuepuka buivi".
eng_text: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Bulelela, codes ya matunga ka itu ni bukokeshi pa copie ya mafi; copie bit a bit wa disque udi ubadibua kakuyi bualu pa biamua bionso pikala wa bulelela muikale.
eng_text: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Tshipatshila tshilelela mbua kupesha kumpanyi eyi bukontolodi bukole mu kusumbisha kuabu; mmalu a kunyunguluja makuta.
eng_text: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Mudi miyiki ipitshila pa enternete, kuena ni dijinga dia kubikila kumpanyi wa telefone udi mu nzubu muebe anyi diba dia kuya mu luendu.
eng_text: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Kakuena dijinga dia kupeta numero wa mu ditunga mu udi usombela; udi mua kupeta enternete ku pitshila satelite mu miaba ya tshisuku ya Chicken, mu Alaska, ni kusungula numero udi uleja ni udi mu munya wa Arizona.
eng_text: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Pa tshibidilu, udi ni tsha kusumba numero wa buloba bujima udi wambuluisha ma telefone RTPC bua kuku bikila. Kudi numero umbukila kudi kuleja dishilangana kudi badi baku bikila.
eng_text: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Tshishuntuludi tsha miaku pa lukasa - application udi mua kushuntula miaku musangu umue bitupa bijima bia mifundu ya muaku ku mukuabu.
eng_text: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Application mikuabu ya nunku idi nansha mua kushuntula mifundu ya miakulu ya mu matunga menyi pa ma panneaux anyi bintu bikuabu bia pa buloba bulelela padi muntu utangija smartphone wende ku tshintu atshi.
eng_text: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Bishuntuludi bia miaku mbiye kumpala menemene ni bishuntula mpidiewu bimpe kakese (ni bia bibi kabiyi pa tshibidilu), kadi bijinga kudimuka, bualu bidi mua kudishima.
eng_text: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Google Translate ki application muimpe bua bia nunku, utuushuntula miakulu nansha ka kuyi enternete wewe mumane ku telecharge bintu bionso bia miakulu bidi musue.
eng_text: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Ditumikija dia ma application a GPS pa kamua kebe bidi mua kuikala mushindu mupupale ni muimpe wa kuya pa enternete paudi mu matunga makuabu.
eng_text: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Bidi biambuluisha kulama makuta pamutu pa kusumba tuarte tukuabu tua GPS, ka tshamua tsha GPS anyi kufutshila tshamua ku kumpanyi wa kufutshila mashinyi.
eng_text: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Wewe kuyi ni mushindu wa kutumikija enternete mu telephone webe, anyi yeye kule, buimpe buayi butu bulua bukese anyi kabuyi ku.
eng_text: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Magasin onso a pa miaba idi ni tuarte prepaye tuabunyi tua tuamua tudi mua kutumikishibua mu tuamua tua bantu bonso anyi ka tshanana.
